<p style="font-size: medium;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;">



僕もそんなカッコいいことはしてません。

超泥臭いです。</span></p>
<p style="font-size: medium;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;"></span></p>
<p style="font-size: medium;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;">



例えばX。

ポストと言っても、
目的と意図によって位置付けは違います。</span></p>
<p style="font-size: medium;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;"></span></p>
<p style="font-size: medium;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;">

&darr;

<span style="font-weight: bold;">・インプを伸ばして認知を取り、
　新規を取り込むポスト</span></span></p>
<p style="font-size: medium;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;"><span style="font-weight: bold;">
・リーチした新規をファンに変えるポスト</span></span></p>
<p style="font-size: medium;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;"><span style="font-weight: bold;">
・ファンを顧客に変えるポスト</span></span></p>
<p style="font-size: medium;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;"><span style="font-weight: bold;">
・&uarr;3つを1つのポストで完結させるポスト</span></span></p>
<p style="font-size: medium;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;"><span style="font-weight: bold;">・フォローしてもらうためのポスト</span></span></p>
<p style="font-size: medium;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;"><span style="font-weight: bold;">
・リプをもらうためのポスト</span></span></p>
<p style="font-size: medium;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;"><span style="font-weight: bold;">
・プロフィールを見てもらうためのポスト</span></span></p>
<p style="font-size: medium;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;"><span style="font-weight: bold;">
・DMに来てもらうためのポスト</span></span></p>
<p style="font-size: medium;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;"><span style="font-weight: bold;">
・いいねをもらうためのポスト</span></span></p>
<p style="font-size: medium;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;"><span style="font-weight: bold;">
・コンテンツを買ってもらうためのポスト</span></span></p>
<p style="font-size: medium;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;"><span style="font-weight: bold;">
・LINEメルマガに来てもらうためのポスト</span></span></p>
<p style="font-size: medium;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;"><span style="font-weight: bold;">
・上記全てを1つに圧縮したポスト</span></span></p>
<p style="font-size: medium;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;"><span style="font-weight: bold;">
・ファンではなく他の発信者に向けた
　抽象度の高い共感狙いのポスト</span>
</span></p>
<p style="font-size: medium;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;"></span></p>
<p style="font-size: medium;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;">


</span></p>
<p style="font-size: medium;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;">
パッと挙げるだけでも
これだけ意図と枠組みがあります。
</span></p>
<p style="font-size: medium;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;"></span></p>
<p style="font-size: medium;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;">

</span></p>
<p style="font-size: medium;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;">
もちろん、
LINE・メルマガも含まれますね
</span></p>
<p style="font-size: medium;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;"></span></p>
<p style="font-size: medium;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;">

</span></p>
<p style="font-size: medium;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;">
ビジネスに関する行動すべてにおいて、
明確な意図を持って取り組み、数値で結果を見る。
</span></p>
<p style="font-size: medium;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;"></span></p>
<p style="font-size: medium;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;"></span></p>
<p style="font-size: medium;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;">


</span></p>
<p style="font-size: medium;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;">
失敗すれば反省点を洗い出し、
上手くいけば細かく言語化する。
</span></p>
<p style="font-size: medium;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;"></span></p>
<p style="font-size: medium;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;"></span></p>
<p style="font-size: medium;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;">


やること多すぎ。。。。
と思うかもしれませんが大丈夫です。</span></p>
<p style="font-size: medium;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;"></span></p>
<p style="font-size: medium;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;"></span></p>
<p style="font-size: medium;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;">



最初からすべてやるのは
「現実的に不可能」です。</span></p>
<p style="font-size: medium;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;"></span></p>
<p style="font-size: medium;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;">



<span style="font-weight: bold;">少しずつ自分で
</span></span><span style="background-color: inherit; font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve; font-weight: bold;">コントロールできる範囲を増やしていく
泥臭い経験値ゲームですね。</span></p>
<p style="font-size: medium;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;"></span></p>
<p style="font-size: medium;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;"></span></p>
<p style="font-size: medium;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;">


そして...</span></p>
<p style="font-size: medium;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;"></span></p>
<p style="font-size: medium;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;">

</span></p>
<p style="font-size: medium;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;">
<span style="font-weight: bold;">
『意図・目的に合わせて
思考と試行を繰り返し、

自身の勝ちパターンを言語化して、
より多くの&ldquo;再現性のある手札&rdquo;
を持っている人が強い』</span>

です。
</span></p>
<p style="font-size: medium;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;"></span></p>
<p style="font-size: medium;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;">

</span></p>
<p style="font-size: medium;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;">
ここでいう再現性とは
万人が使えるという意味ではなく、

自分が意図して
同じ結果を作り出せるかどうかです。
</span></p>
<p style="font-size: medium;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;"></span></p>
<p style="font-size: medium;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;"></span></p>
<p style="font-size: medium;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;">

</span></p>
<p style="font-size: medium;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;">
僕が過去に
「単語が重要」と言っていたのも

ただ単にSEO的に単語を散りばめるわけではなくて、

このベースとなる思考と試行の結果ありきの判断です。</span></p>
<p style="font-size: medium;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;"></span></p>
<p style="font-size: medium;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;">

</span></p>
<p style="font-size: medium;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;">

どんな単語を入れると、
自分の見込み客がどんな反応するのか、
何を思うのか、何を期待するのか、
ポストを読み進めてくれるのか、
最終的にどんなアクションを起こしてくれるのか....
</span></p>
<p style="font-size: medium;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;"></span></p>
<p style="font-size: medium;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;">

</span></p>
<p style="font-size: medium;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;">
察しの良い</span>%name2%さんなら、<span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;">
ここまで読んで気づかれたはずです。
</span></p>
<p style="font-size: medium;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;"></span></p>
<p style="font-size: medium;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;">

</span></p>
<p style="font-size: medium;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;">
僕が一番言いたいことは....

</span><span style="font-weight: bold;">%name2%さん<span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;">のビジネスの
勝ちパターンや最適解は、</span></span></p>
<p style="font-size: medium;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;"></span></p>
<p style="font-size: medium;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;">

</span><span style="color: rgb(156, 0, 0); font-weight: bold;">%name2%さん</span><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;"><span style="color: rgb(156, 0, 0); font-weight: bold;">が思考と試行の繰り返しの中で
見つけていくしかない</span>

ということ。
</span></p>
<p style="font-size: medium;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;"></span></p>
<p style="font-size: medium;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;"></span></p>

</span></p>
<p style="font-size: medium;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;">
コンテンツ、サポート、コンサルは
飽くまでそれをよりはやく
確実に見つけるための手助けです。
</span></p>
<p style="font-size: medium;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;"></span></p>

<p style="font-size: medium;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="font-size: medium;">さて、今日はこんなテーマでお話しします。<br><br><br></p>
<span style="white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit; font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif;"><span style="font-weight: bold;">思考と試行</span>がすべて。</span><p style="font-size: medium;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="font-size: medium;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; white-space-collapse: preserve;"><br></span></p>
<span style="white-space-collapse: preserve; font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-weight: bold;">コンテンツビジネスで成果を出すためには...

いきなりハンターハンターのタイトル
みたいなつかみで申し訳ないんですが、、、</span></p>
<p style="font-size: medium;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;"></span></p>
<p style="font-size: medium;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;">



ここでいう思考って
「とにかく考えろ！頭を使え！」</span></p>
<p style="font-size: medium;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;"></span></p>
<p style="font-size: medium;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;">

みたいな抽象的なことではなくて
</span></p>
<p style="font-size: medium;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;"></span></p>
<p style="font-size: medium;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;">


すべての行動に対して、

「明確な意図がありその結果を
数字で振り返る&ldquo;つもり&rdquo;があるかどうか」

「そして思考は目に見える形で
まずは試行しなければ始まらない」

と思ってます。

いや、カッコつけました。</span></p>
<p style="font-size: medium;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;"></span></p>

たしかに「」はついてますが、
チョット大袈裟な表現ですね。</span></p>
<p style="font-size: medium;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;"></span></p>

僕もそんなカッコいいことはしてません。

超泥臭いです。</span></p>
<p style="font-size: medium;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;"></span></p>

例えばX。

ポストと言っても、
目的と意図によって位置付けは違います。</span></p>
<p style="font-size: medium;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;"></span></p>
<p style="font-size: medium;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;">

&darr;

<span style="font-weight: bold;">・インプを伸ばして認知を取り、
　新規を取り込むポスト</span></span></p>
<p style="font-size: medium;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;"><span style="font-weight: bold;">
・リーチした新規をファンに変えるポスト</span></span></p>
<p style="font-size: medium;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;"><span style="font-weight: bold;">
・ファンを顧客に変えるポスト</span></span></p>
<p style="font-size: medium;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;"><span style="font-weight: bold;">
・&uarr;3つを1つのポストで完結させるポスト</span></span></p>
<p style="font-size: medium;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;"><span style="font-weight: bold;">・フォローしてもらうためのポスト</span></span></p>
<p style="font-size: medium;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;"><span style="font-weight: bold;">
・リプをもらうためのポスト</span></span></p>
<p style="font-size: medium;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;"><span style="font-weight: bold;">

<p style="font-size: medium;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;"><span style="font-weight: bold;">

・いいねをもらうためのポスト</span></span></p>
<p style="font-size: medium;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;"><span style="font-weight: bold;">
・コンテンツを買ってもらうためのポスト</span></span></p>
<p style="font-size: medium;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;"><span style="font-weight: bold;">
・LINEメルマガに来てもらうためのポスト</span></span></p>
<p style="font-size: medium;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;"><span style="font-weight: bold;">
・上記全てを1つに圧縮したポスト</span></span></p>
<p style="font-size: medium;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;"><span style="font-weight: bold;">
・ファンではなく他の発信者に向けた
　抽象度の高い共感狙いのポスト</span>
</span></p>
<p style="font-size: medium;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;"></span></p>
<p style="font-size: medium;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;">


</span></p>
<p style="font-size: medium;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;">
パッと挙げるだけでも
これだけ意図と枠組みがあります。
</span></p>
<p style="font-size: medium;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;"></span></p>
<p style="font-size: medium;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;">

</span></p>
<p style="font-size: medium;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;">
もちろん、
LINE・メルマガも含まれますね
</span></p>
<p style="font-size: medium;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;"></span></p>

</span></p>
<p style="font-size: medium;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;">
ビジネスに関する行動すべてにおいて、
明確な意図を持って取り組み、数値で結果を見る。
</span></p>
<p style="font-size: medium;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;"></span></p>
<p style="font-size: medium;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;"></span></p>

<p style="font-size: medium;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;">

<p style="font-size: medium;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;"></span></p>

<p style="font-size: medium;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;">


やること多すぎ。。。。
と思うかもしれませんが大丈夫です。</span></p>
<p style="font-size: medium;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;"></span></p>

<p style="font-size: medium;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;">



最初からすべてやるのは
「現実的に不可能」です。</span></p>
<p style="font-size: medium;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;"></span></p>
<p style="font-size: medium;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;">



<span style="font-weight: bold;">少しずつ自分で
</span></span><span style="background-color: inherit; font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve; font-weight: bold;">コントロールできる範囲を増やしていく
泥臭い経験値ゲームですね。</span></p>
<p style="font-size: medium;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;"></span></p>
<p style="font-size: medium;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;"></span></p>
<p style="font-size: medium;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;">


そして...</span></p>
<p style="font-size: medium;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;"></span></p>
<p style="font-size: medium;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;">

</span></p>
<p style="font-size: medium;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;">
<span style="font-weight: bold;">
『意図・目的に合わせて
思考と試行を繰り返し、

自身の勝ちパターンを言語化して、
より多くの&ldquo;再現性のある手札&rdquo;
を持っている人が強い』</span>

です。
</span></p>
<p style="font-size: medium;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;"></span></p>
<p style="font-size: medium;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;">

<p style="font-size: medium;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;">

万人が使えるという意味ではなく、

自分が意図して
同じ結果を作り出せるかどうかです。
</span></p>
<p style="font-size: medium;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;"></span></p>
<p style="font-size: medium;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;"></span></p>
<p style="font-size: medium;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;">

</span></p>
<p style="font-size: medium;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;">
僕が過去に
「単語が重要」と言っていたのも

ただ単にSEO的に単語を散りばめるわけではなくて、

このベースとなる思考と試行の結果ありきの判断です。</span></p>
<p style="font-size: medium;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;"></span></p>

</span></p>
<p style="font-size: medium;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;">

どんな単語を入れると、
自分の見込み客がどんな反応するのか、
何を思うのか、何を期待するのか、
ポストを読み進めてくれるのか、
最終的にどんなアクションを起こしてくれるのか....
</span></p>
<p style="font-size: medium;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;"></span></p>
<p style="font-size: medium;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;">

</span></p>
<p style="font-size: medium;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;">

<p style="font-size: medium;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;"></span></p>

<p style="font-size: medium;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;">

</span><span style="font-weight: bold;">%name2%さん<span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;">のビジネスの

<p style="font-size: medium;"><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;"></span></p>

</span><span style="color: rgb(156, 0, 0); font-weight: bold;">%name2%さん</span><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;"><span style="color: rgb(156, 0, 0); font-weight: bold;">が思考と試行の繰り返しの中で

<p class="p1" style="color: rgb(55, 65, 81); font-family: &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;; font-size: 13px; margin-bottom: 0px; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-stretch: normal; line-height: normal;"><span style="font-size: 16px;">③の関係を深める(価値提供)</span></p>
<p class="p1" style="color: rgb(55, 65, 81); font-family: &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;; font-size: 13px; margin-bottom: 0px; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-stretch: normal; line-height: normal;"><span style="font-size: 16px;">が前倒しで行われている状態。</span></p>
<p class="p2" style="color: rgb(55, 65, 81); font-family: &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;; font-size: 13px; min-height: 15px; margin-bottom: 0px; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-stretch: normal; line-height: normal;">&nbsp;</p>
<p class="p2" style="color: rgb(55, 65, 81); font-family: &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;; font-size: 13px; min-height: 15px; margin-bottom: 0px; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-stretch: normal; line-height: normal;">&nbsp;</p>
<p class="p2" style="color: rgb(55, 65, 81); font-family: &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;; font-size: 13px; min-height: 15px; margin-bottom: 0px; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-stretch: normal; line-height: normal;">&nbsp;</p>
<p class="p2" style="color: rgb(55, 65, 81); font-family: &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;; font-size: 13px; min-height: 15px; margin-bottom: 0px; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-stretch: normal; line-height: normal;">&nbsp;</p>
<p class="p2" style="color: rgb(55, 65, 81); font-family: &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;; font-size: 13px; min-height: 15px; margin-bottom: 0px; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-stretch: normal; line-height: normal;">&nbsp;</p>
<p class="p2" style="color: rgb(55, 65, 81); font-family: &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;; font-size: 13px; min-height: 15px; margin-bottom: 0px; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-stretch: normal; line-height: normal;"><br><br><br><br><br><br></p>
<p class="p1" style="color: rgb(55, 65, 81); font-family: &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;; font-size: 13px; margin-bottom: 0px; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-stretch: normal; line-height: normal;"><span style="font-size: 16px;">2&#12316;3年前からこの傾向はありましたが、</span></p>
<p class="p1" style="color: rgb(55, 65, 81); font-family: &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;; font-size: 13px; margin-bottom: 0px; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-stretch: normal; line-height: normal;"><span style="font-size: 16px;">今は顕著に教育が先行してます。</span></p>
<p class="p1" style="color: rgb(55, 65, 81); font-family: &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;; font-size: 13px; margin-bottom: 0px; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-stretch: normal; line-height: normal;"><span style="font-size: 16px;"></span></p>

<p class="p1" style="color: rgb(55, 65, 81); font-family: &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;; font-size: 13px; margin-bottom: 0px; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-stretch: normal; line-height: normal;"><span style="font-size: 16px;"></span></p>
<p class="p1" style="color: rgb(55, 65, 81); font-family: &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;; font-size: 13px; margin-bottom: 0px; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-stretch: normal; line-height: normal;"><span style="font-size: 16px;"></span></p>
<p class="p1" style="color: rgb(55, 65, 81); font-family: &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;; font-size: 13px; margin-bottom: 0px; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-stretch: normal; line-height: normal;"><span style="font-size: 16px;"><br><br><br><br><br></span></p>
<p class="p2" style="color: rgb(55, 65, 81); font-family: &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;; font-size: 13px; min-height: 15px; margin-bottom: 0px; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-stretch: normal; line-height: normal;"><br></p>
<p class="p1" style="color: rgb(55, 65, 81); font-family: &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;; font-size: 13px; margin-bottom: 0px; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-stretch: normal; line-height: normal;"><span style="font-size: 16px;">要するに、</span></p>
<p class="p3" style="color: rgb(55, 65, 81); font-family: &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;; font-size: 13px; min-height: 16px; margin-bottom: 0px; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-stretch: normal; line-height: normal;"><b></b><br><br><br></p>
<p class="p1" style="color: rgb(55, 65, 81); font-family: &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;; font-size: 13px; margin-bottom: 0px; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-stretch: normal; line-height: normal;"><b><span style="font-size: 16px;">━━━━━━━━━━━</span></b></p>
<p class="p3" style="color: rgb(55, 65, 81); font-family: &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;; font-size: 13px; min-height: 16px; margin-bottom: 0px; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-stretch: normal; line-height: normal;"><b></b><br></p>
<p class="p1" style="color: rgb(55, 65, 81); font-family: &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;; font-size: 13px; margin-bottom: 0px; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-stretch: normal; line-height: normal;"><b><span style="font-size: 16px;">タイムラインが、</span></b></p>
<p class="p1" style="color: rgb(55, 65, 81); font-family: &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;; font-size: 13px; margin-bottom: 0px; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-stretch: normal; line-height: normal;"><b><span style="font-size: 16px;">メルマガや有料教材並みの情報で</span></b></p>
<p class="p1" style="color: rgb(55, 65, 81); font-family: &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;; font-size: 13px; margin-bottom: 0px; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-stretch: normal; line-height: normal;"><b><span style="font-size: 16px;">溢れているということ。</span></b></p>
<p class="p3" style="color: rgb(55, 65, 81); font-family: &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;; font-size: 13px; min-height: 16px; margin-bottom: 0px; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-stretch: normal; line-height: normal;"><b></b><br></p>
<p class="p1" style="color: rgb(55, 65, 81); font-family: &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;; font-size: 13px; margin-bottom: 0px; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-stretch: normal; line-height: normal;"><b><span style="font-size: 16px;">━━━━━━━━━━━</span></b></p>
<p class="p1" style="color: rgb(55, 65, 81); font-family: &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;; font-size: 13px; margin-bottom: 0px; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-stretch: normal; line-height: normal;"><b><span style="font-size: 16px;"></span></b></p>
<p class="p1" style="color: rgb(55, 65, 81); font-family: &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;; font-size: 13px; margin-bottom: 0px; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-stretch: normal; line-height: normal;"><b><span style="font-size: 16px;"></span></b></p>
<p class="p1" style="color: rgb(55, 65, 81); font-family: &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;; font-size: 13px; margin-bottom: 0px; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-stretch: normal; line-height: normal;"><b><span style="font-size: 16px;"></span></b></p>
<p class="p1" style="color: rgb(55, 65, 81); font-family: &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;; font-size: 13px; margin-bottom: 0px; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-stretch: normal; line-height: normal;"><b><span style="font-size: 16px;"></span></b></p>
<p class="p1" style="color: rgb(55, 65, 81); font-family: &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;; font-size: 13px; margin-bottom: 0px; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-stretch: normal; line-height: normal;"><b><span style="font-size: 16px;"><br><br><br><br><br></span></b></p>
<p class="p2" style="color: rgb(55, 65, 81); font-family: &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;; font-size: 13px; min-height: 15px; margin-bottom: 0px; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-stretch: normal; line-height: normal;"><br></p>
<p class="p1" style="color: rgb(55, 65, 81); font-family: &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;; font-size: 13px; margin-bottom: 0px; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-stretch: normal; line-height: normal;"><span style="font-size: 16px;">理由として考えられるのは、</span></p>
<p class="p1" style="color: rgb(55, 65, 81); font-family: &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;; font-size: 13px; margin-bottom: 0px; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-stretch: normal; line-height: normal;"><span style="font-size: 16px;">他の発信者との差別化を図ろうとして、</span></p>
<p class="p1" style="color: rgb(55, 65, 81); font-family: &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;; font-size: 13px; margin-bottom: 0px; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-stretch: normal; line-height: normal;"><span style="font-size: 16px;"></span></p>
<p class="p1" style="color: rgb(55, 65, 81); font-family: &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;; font-size: 13px; margin-bottom: 0px; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-stretch: normal; line-height: normal;"><span style="font-size: 16px;"></span></p>
<p class="p1" style="color: rgb(55, 65, 81); font-family: &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;; font-size: 13px; margin-bottom: 0px; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-stretch: normal; line-height: normal;"><span style="font-size: 16px;"></span></p>
<p class="p1" style="color: rgb(55, 65, 81); font-family: &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;; font-size: 13px; margin-bottom: 0px; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-stretch: normal; line-height: normal;"><span style="font-size: 16px;"></span></p>
<p class="p1" style="color: rgb(55, 65, 81); font-family: &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;; font-size: 13px; margin-bottom: 0px; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-stretch: normal; line-height: normal;"><span style="font-size: 16px;"><br><br></span></p>
<p class="p1" style="color: rgb(55, 65, 81); font-family: &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;; font-size: 13px; margin-bottom: 0px; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-stretch: normal; line-height: normal;"><span style="font-size: 16px;"></span></p>
<p class="p2" style="color: rgb(55, 65, 81); font-family: &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;; font-size: 13px; min-height: 15px; margin-bottom: 0px; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-stretch: normal; line-height: normal;"><br></p>
<p class="p1" style="color: rgb(55, 65, 81); font-family: &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;; font-size: 13px; margin-bottom: 0px; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-stretch: normal; line-height: normal;"><span style="font-size: 16px;">本来メルマガや有料で話している内容を</span></p>
<p class="p1" style="color: rgb(55, 65, 81); font-family: &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;; font-size: 13px; margin-bottom: 0px; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-stretch: normal; line-height: normal;"><span style="font-size: 16px;">出さざるを得なくなり競争が激化&rarr;</span></p>
<p class="p2" style="color: rgb(55, 65, 81); font-family: &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;; font-size: 13px; min-height: 15px; margin-bottom: 0px; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-stretch: normal; line-height: normal;"><br></p>
<p class="p1" style="color: rgb(55, 65, 81); font-family: &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;; font-size: 13px; margin-bottom: 0px; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-stretch: normal; line-height: normal;"><span style="font-size: 16px;">&rarr;その結果、</span></p>
<p class="p1" style="color: rgb(55, 65, 81); font-family: &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;; font-size: 13px; margin-bottom: 0px; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-stretch: normal; line-height: normal;"><span style="font-size: 16px;">導線内部や有料で話している情報を出さないと</span></p>
<p class="p1" style="color: rgb(55, 65, 81); font-family: &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;; font-size: 13px; margin-bottom: 0px; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-stretch: normal; line-height: normal;"><span style="font-size: 16px;">ライバルに勝てないという流れができた。</span></p>
<p class="p1" style="color: rgb(55, 65, 81); font-family: &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;; font-size: 13px; margin-bottom: 0px; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-stretch: normal; line-height: normal;"><span style="font-size: 16px;"></span></p>
<p class="p1" style="color: rgb(55, 65, 81); font-family: &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;; font-size: 13px; margin-bottom: 0px; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-stretch: normal; line-height: normal;"><span style="font-size: 16px;"></span></p>
