<div class="ctwlpt-block-faq-dd ctwlpt-block-faq-dd-hide" style="margin: 0px; padding: 2em; border: 0px; outline: 0px; font-size: 12px; vertical-align: baseline; background: rgb(240, 240, 240); font-family: &quot;Noto Sans JP&quot;, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.016px;"><p style="margin-bottom: 0px; padding: 0px; border: 0px; outline: 0px; vertical-align: baseline; background: transparent;">A:一切ございません。<br><br>参加後に全てのコンテンツを受け取っていただけますので、<br>安心してご参加ください。</p>
</div>
<br style="font-size: medium;"><div class="ctwlpt-block-faq-dt ctwlpt-block-faq-dt-icon-minus" style="margin: 0px; padding: 1em; border: 0px rgb(0, 32, 71); outline: 0px; font-size: 12px; vertical-align: baseline; background: rgb(0, 32, 71); display: flex; align-items: center; font-weight: bold; position: relative; transition: 0.2s; font-family: &quot;Noto Sans JP&quot;, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.016px;">
<span class="ctwlpt-block-faq-f" style="color: rgb(243, 215, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; border: 0px; outline: 0px; font-size: 3em; vertical-align: baseline; background-image: initial; background-position: initial; background-size: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-attachment: initial; background-origin: initial; background-clip: initial; font-family: 游明朝, YuMincho, &quot;Hiragino Mincho ProN&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Mincho Pro&quot;, &quot;ＭＳ 明朝&quot;, serif; display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center; font-weight: 100; line-height: 1; position: relative; top: -3px;">Q</span><div class="ctwlpt-block-faq-f-inner" style="margin: 0px; padding: 0px 0px 0px 1em; border: 0px; outline: 0px; vertical-align: baseline; background: transparent;"><span style="font-size: 15px;"><span style="color: rgb(255, 255, 0);">後発</span>&nbsp;
<span style="color: rgb(255, 255, 0);">組だと思う</span><span style="color: rgb(255, 255, 0);">のですが、大丈夫でしょうか？</span></span></div>
</div>
<div class="ctwlpt-block-faq-dd ctwlpt-block-faq-dd-hide" style="margin: 0px; padding: 2em; border: 0px; outline: 0px; font-size: 12px; vertical-align: baseline; background: rgb(240, 240, 240); font-family: &quot;Noto Sans JP&quot;, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.016px;"><p style="margin-bottom: 0px; padding: 0px; border: 0px; outline: 0px; vertical-align: baseline; background: transparent;">A:全く問題ございません。<br><br>特にビジネス系は一見、レッドオーシャン見えるかもしれませんが、そんなことはありません。<br>参入ハードルがないに等しい分、短期間で撤退する方が多いのです。<br><br>新陳代謝が激しいということですね。<br><br>例えば、１月に始めた方が100人いるとしましょう。<br>1ヶ月で60人、3ヶ月で80人、6ヶ月後には95人が辞めています。<br>大げさ 
に聞こえるかもしれませんが悲しいことに事実です。。<br><br>後発組でも勝てる理由としては、多くの人の場合、<br>・インプットばかりでそもそも行動を起こしていない人が大多数<br>・いろんなノウハウに手を出してノウハウコレクターになってしまっている<br>・正しい知識がないから結果が出ずにすぐに辞めていく<br>こんな状態に陥ってしまっています。<br><br>ただ、明鏡試遂で学んだ知識を活かして、<br>継続して行動すれば結果は出ます。</p>
</div>
<br style="font-size: medium;"><div class="ctwlpt-block-faq-dt ctwlpt-block-faq-dt-icon-minus" style="margin: 0px; padding: 1em; border: 0px rgb(0, 32, 71); outline: 0px; font-size: 12px; vertical-align: baseline; background: rgb(0, 32, 71); display: flex; align-items: center; font-weight: bold; position: relative; transition: 0.2s; font-family: &quot;Noto Sans JP&quot;, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.016px;">
<span class="ctwlpt-block-faq-f" style="color: rgb(243, 215, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; border: 0px; outline: 0px; font-size: 3em; vertical-align: baseline; background-image: initial; background-position: initial; background-size: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-attachment: initial; background-origin: initial; background-clip: initial; font-family: 游明朝, YuMincho, &quot;Hiragino Mincho ProN&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Mincho Pro&quot;, &quot;ＭＳ 明朝&quot;, serif; display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center; font-weight: 100; line-height: 1; position: relative; top: -3px;">Q</span><div class="ctwlpt-block-faq-f-inner" style="margin: 0px; padding: 0px 0px 0px 1em; border: 0px; outline: 0px; vertical-align: baseline; background: transparent;"><span style="color: rgb(255, 255, 0); font-size: 15px;">実績も実力も魅力も自分にはないと思 
うのですが&hellip;</span></div>
</div>
<div class="ctwlpt-block-faq-dd ctwlpt-block-faq-dd-hide" style="margin: 0px; padding: 2em; border: 0px; outline: 0px; font-size: 12px; vertical-align: baseline; background: rgb(240, 240, 240); font-family: &quot;Noto Sans JP&quot;, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.016px;"><p style="margin-bottom: 0px; padding: 0px; border: 0px; outline: 0px; vertical-align: baseline; background: transparent;">A:全く問題ございません。<br><br>そして、実績・実力・魅力がない方はこの世に存在しません。必ずあります。<br>その言語化、発信への活かし方などについても講座内でお話ししておりますので、安心してご参加ください。</p>
</div>
<br style="font-size: medium;"><div class="ctwlpt-block-faq-dt ctwlpt-block-faq-dt-icon-minus" style="margin: 0px; padding: 1em; border: 0px rgb(0, 32, 71); outline: 0px; font-size: 12px; vertical-align: baseline; background: rgb(0, 32, 71); display: flex; align-items: center; font-weight: bold; position: relative; transition: 0.2s; font-family: &quot;Noto Sans JP&quot;, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.016px;">
<span class="ctwlpt-block-faq-f" style="color: rgb(243, 215, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; border: 0px; outline: 0px; font-size: 3em; vertical-align: baseline; background-image: initial; background-position: initial; background-size: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-attachment: initial; background-origin: initial; background-clip: initial; font-family: 游明朝, YuMincho, &quot;Hiragino Mincho ProN&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Mincho Pro&quot;, &quot;ＭＳ 明朝&quot;, serif; display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center; font-weight: 100; line-height: 1; position: relative; top: -3px;">Q</span><div class="ctwlpt-block-faq-f-inner" style="margin: 0px; padding: 0px 0px 0px 1em; border: 0px; outline: 0px; vertical-align: baseline; background: transparent;"><span style="color: rgb(255, 255, 0); font-size: 15px;">他の教材やスクール、講座との明確な 
違いはなんですか？</span></div>
</div>
<div class="ctwlpt-block-faq-dd ctwlpt-block-faq-dd-hide" style="margin: 0px; padding: 2em; border: 0px; outline: 0px; font-size: 12px; vertical-align: baseline; background: rgb(240, 240, 240); font-family: &quot;Noto Sans JP&quot;, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.016px;"><p style="margin-bottom: 0px; padding: 0px; border: 0px; outline: 0px; vertical-align: baseline; background: transparent;">A:ひとことで言えば「超実践的」です。<br><br>現場で必要なもののみを重点的に完備し、目標達成において遠回りになるもの、<br>今すぐに必要のないもの、成果に直結しづらいものを避けて、<br>最短で売れる仕組みを作るというゴールに辿り着いていただいております。</p>
</div>
<br style="font-size: medium;"><div class="ctwlpt-block-faq-dt ctwlpt-block-faq-dt-icon-minus" style="margin: 0px; padding: 1em; border: 0px rgb(0, 32, 71); outline: 0px; font-size: 12px; vertical-align: baseline; background: rgb(0, 32, 71); display: flex; align-items: center; font-weight: bold; position: relative; transition: 0.2s; font-family: &quot;Noto Sans JP&quot;, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.016px;">
<span class="ctwlpt-block-faq-f" style="color: rgb(243, 215, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; border: 0px; outline: 0px; font-size: 3em; vertical-align: baseline; background-image: initial; background-position: initial; background-size: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-attachment: initial; background-origin: initial; background-clip: initial; font-family: 游明朝, YuMincho, &quot;Hiragino Mincho ProN&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Mincho Pro&quot;, &quot;ＭＳ 明朝&quot;, serif; display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center; font-weight: 100; line-height: 1; position: relative; top: -3px;">Q</span><div class="ctwlpt-block-faq-f-inner" style="margin: 0px; padding: 0px 0px 0px 1em; border: 0px; outline: 0px; vertical-align: baseline; background: transparent;"><span style="color: rgb(255, 255, 0); font-size: 15px;">完全な初心者です。参加しても大丈夫 
なのでしょうか？</span></div>
</div>
<div class="ctwlpt-block-faq-dd ctwlpt-block-faq-dd-hide" style="margin: 0px; padding: 2em; border: 0px; outline: 0px; font-size: 12px; vertical-align: baseline; background: rgb(240, 240, 240); font-family: &quot;Noto Sans JP&quot;, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.016px;"><p style="margin-bottom: 0px; padding: 0px; border: 0px; outline: 0px; vertical-align: baseline; background: transparent;">A：全く問題ございません。<br><br>初心者の方にこそ、<br>最初から最短ルートで仕組み化まで進めたいただきたいです。</p>
</div>
<br style="font-size: medium;"><div class="ctwlpt-block-faq-dt ctwlpt-block-faq-dt-icon-minus" style="margin: 0px; padding: 1em; border: 0px rgb(0, 32, 71); outline: 0px; font-size: 12px; vertical-align: baseline; background: rgb(0, 32, 71); display: flex; align-items: center; font-weight: bold; position: relative; transition: 0.2s; font-family: &quot;Noto Sans JP&quot;, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.016px;">
<span class="ctwlpt-block-faq-f" style="color: rgb(243, 215, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; border: 0px; outline: 0px; font-size: 3em; vertical-align: baseline; background-image: initial; background-position: initial; background-size: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-attachment: initial; background-origin: initial; background-clip: initial; font-family: 游明朝, YuMincho, &quot;Hiragino Mincho ProN&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Mincho Pro&quot;, &quot;ＭＳ 明朝&quot;, serif; display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center; font-weight: 100; line-height: 1; position: relative; top: -3px;">Q</span><div class="ctwlpt-block-faq-f-inner" style="margin: 0px; padding: 0px 0px 0px 1em; border: 0px; outline: 0px; vertical-align: baseline; background: transparent;"><span style="color: rgb(255, 255, 0); font-size: 15px;">既に少し仕組み化を進めています。そ 
れでも大丈夫ですか？</span></div>
</div>
<div class="ctwlpt-block-faq-dd ctwlpt-block-faq-dd-hide" style="margin: 0px; padding: 2em; border: 0px; outline: 0px; font-size: 12px; vertical-align: baseline; background: rgb(240, 240, 240); font-family: &quot;Noto Sans JP&quot;, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.016px;"><p style="margin-bottom: 0px; padding: 0px; border: 0px; outline: 0px; vertical-align: baseline; background: transparent;">A:大歓迎です。<br><br>お伝えした通り0&rarr;1はもちろん、<br>100以上を目指す方のためのカリキュラムやロードマップ、具体的な施策を完備し、<br>今ある仕組みを変えて、参加後１週間でで大きな売上を出される方もいらっしゃいます。<br>講座でお待ちしております。</p>
</div>
<br style="font-size: medium;"><div class="ctwlpt-block-faq-dt ctwlpt-block-faq-dt-icon-minus" style="margin: 0px; padding: 1em; border: 0px rgb(0, 32, 71); outline: 0px; font-size: 12px; vertical-align: baseline; background: rgb(0, 32, 71); display: flex; align-items: center; font-weight: bold; position: relative; transition: 0.2s; font-family: &quot;Noto Sans JP&quot;, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.016px;">
<span class="ctwlpt-block-faq-f" style="color: rgb(243, 215, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; border: 0px; outline: 0px; font-size: 3em; vertical-align: baseline; background-image: initial; background-position: initial; background-size: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-attachment: initial; background-origin: initial; background-clip: initial; font-family: 游明朝, YuMincho, &quot;Hiragino Mincho ProN&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Mincho Pro&quot;, &quot;ＭＳ 明朝&quot;, serif; display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center; font-weight: 100; line-height: 1; position: relative; top: -3px;">Q</span><div class="ctwlpt-block-faq-f-inner" style="margin: 0px; padding: 0px 0px 0px 1em; border: 0px; outline: 0px; vertical-align: baseline; background: transparent;"><span style="color: rgb(255, 255, 0); font-size: 15px;">ひとことでどんな方向けの講座ですか 
？</span></div>
</div>
<div class="ctwlpt-block-faq-dd ctwlpt-block-faq-dd-hide" style="margin: 0px; padding: 2em; border: 0px; outline: 0px; font-size: 12px; vertical-align: baseline; background: rgb(240, 240, 240); font-family: &quot;Noto Sans JP&quot;, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.016px;"><p style="margin-bottom: 0px; padding: 0px; border: 0px; outline: 0px; vertical-align: baseline; background: transparent;">A:ひとことではちょっと足りないのですが&hellip;<br><br>・これからコンテンツビジネスを始められる方<br>・既にコンテンツは持っていて仕組み化に向けて動き出したい方<br><br>こんな方向けです。</p>
</div>
<br style="font-size: medium;"><div class="ctwlpt-block-faq-dt ctwlpt-block-faq-dt-icon-minus" style="margin: 0px; padding: 1em; border: 0px rgb(0, 32, 71); outline: 0px; font-size: 12px; vertical-align: baseline; background: rgb(0, 32, 71); display: flex; align-items: center; font-weight: bold; position: relative; transition: 0.2s; font-family: &quot;Noto Sans JP&quot;, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.016px;">
<span class="ctwlpt-block-faq-f" style="color: rgb(243, 215, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; border: 0px; outline: 0px; font-size: 3em; vertical-align: baseline; background-image: initial; background-position: initial; background-size: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-attachment: initial; background-origin: initial; background-clip: initial; font-family: 游明朝, YuMincho, &quot;Hiragino Mincho ProN&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Mincho Pro&quot;, &quot;ＭＳ 明朝&quot;, serif; display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center; font-weight: 100; line-height: 1; position: relative; top: -3px;">Q</span><div class="ctwlpt-block-faq-f-inner" style="margin: 0px; padding: 0px 0px 0px 1em; border: 0px; outline: 0px; vertical-align: baseline; background: transparent;"><span style="color: rgb(255, 255, 0); font-size: 15px;">顔出しは必要ですか？</span></div>
</div>
<div class="ctwlpt-block-faq-dd ctwlpt-block-faq-dd-hide" style="margin: 0px; padding: 2em; border: 0px; outline: 0px; font-size: 12px; vertical-align: baseline; background: rgb(240, 240, 240); font-family: &quot;Noto Sans JP&quot;, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.016px;"><p style="margin-bottom: 0px; padding: 0px; border: 0px; outline: 0px; vertical-align: baseline; background: transparent;">A:必要ございません。<br><br>「いや、おんゆー顔出してるじゃん」と思われるかもしれませんが、<br>開始当初は顔出しなしで売上を上げ続けていました。<br><br>私が顔を出したのは気まぐれで、<br>出しても出さなくてもどちらでも良い環境だったというのが大きいです。<br><br>後悔は全くしていませんが、<br>出す必要も特になかったかなと今では思っております。<br>&nbsp;<br>顔
 を出していないから信用されない、なんてことはありません。<br>しっかりと価値が提供できていれば、顔出し無しでも十分収益化できます。<br><br>実際、受講生の方の９割以上が顔出しなしで成果を出されています。<br><br>また、「声で会社や友人・家族にバレるんじゃないか？」<br>という心配もあるかもしれませんが、声だけでバレたという報告は聞いたことがありません。<br><br>バレるとしたら、作業中に見つかるなどそれくらいだと思われます。</p>
</div>

うとしています。</span><br><span style="color: rgb(255, 255, 0); font-size: 15px;">まだ始めていませんが参加すべきですか？</span></div>

じでも、1日１、2時間確保して継続していただければ問題なく進められるペースです。<br><br>各ロードマップにかかる時間の目安や作業時間の目安、モチベーションの管理方法や自己管理方法についてもコンテンツ内に完備しておりますので、安心してご参加ください。</p>

 悩んでいます。</span></span><br><span style="color: rgb(255, 255, 0); font-size: 15px;">ひとことで言うと大きな違いはなんですか？</span></div>

<br><br>スタンダードでも十分ですが、<br>高みを目指す方や確実さを重視する方はプレミアムならまず安心です。</p>

<br style="font-size: medium;"><div class="ctwlpt-block-faq-dt ctwlpt-block-faq-dt-icon-minus" style="margin: 0px; padding: 1em; border: 0px rgb(0, 32, 71); outline: 0px; font-size: 12px; vertical-align: baseline; background: rgb(0, 32, 71); display: flex; align-items: center; font-weight: bold; position: relative; transition: 0.2s; font-family: &quot;Noto Sans JP&quot;, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.016px;">

<div class="ctwlpt-block-faq-dd ctwlpt-block-faq-dd-hide" style="margin: 0px; padding: 2em; border: 0px; outline: 0px; font-size: 12px; vertical-align: baseline; background: rgb(240, 240, 240); font-family: &quot;Noto Sans JP&quot;, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.016px;"><p style="margin-bottom: 0px; padding: 0px; border: 0px; outline: 0px; vertical-align: baseline; background: transparent;">A:一切ございません。<br><br>参加後に全てのコンテンツを受け取っていただけますので、<br>安心してご参加ください。</p>
</div>
<br style="font-size: medium;"><div class="ctwlpt-block-faq-dt ctwlpt-block-faq-dt-icon-minus" style="margin: 0px; padding: 1em; border: 0px rgb(0, 32, 71); outline: 0px; font-size: 12px; vertical-align: baseline; background: rgb(0, 32, 71); display: flex; align-items: center; font-weight: bold; position: relative; transition: 0.2s; font-family: &quot;Noto Sans JP&quot;, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.016px;">
<span class="ctwlpt-block-faq-f" style="color: rgb(243, 215, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; border: 0px; outline: 0px; font-size: 3em; vertical-align: baseline; background-image: initial; background-position: initial; background-size: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-attachment: initial; background-origin: initial; background-clip: initial; font-family: 游明朝, YuMincho, &quot;Hiragino Mincho ProN&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Mincho Pro&quot;, &quot;ＭＳ 明朝&quot;, serif; display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center; font-weight: 100; line-height: 1; position: relative; top: -3px;">Q</span><div class="ctwlpt-block-faq-f-inner" style="margin: 0px; padding: 0px 0px 0px 1em; border: 0px; outline: 0px; vertical-align: baseline; background: transparent;"><span style="font-size: 15px;"><span style="color: rgb(255, 255, 0);">後発</span>&nbsp;
<span style="color: rgb(255, 255, 0);">組だと思う</span><span style="color: rgb(255, 255, 0);">のですが、大丈夫でしょうか？</span></span></div>
</div>
<div class="ctwlpt-block-faq-dd ctwlpt-block-faq-dd-hide" style="margin: 0px; padding: 2em; border: 0px; outline: 0px; font-size: 12px; vertical-align: baseline; background: rgb(240, 240, 240); font-family: &quot;Noto Sans JP&quot;, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.016px;"><p style="margin-bottom: 0px; padding: 0px; border: 0px; outline: 0px; vertical-align: baseline; background: transparent;">A:全く問題ございません。<br><br>特にビジネス系は一見、レッドオーシャン見えるかもしれませんが、そんなことはありません。<br>参入ハードルがないに等しい分、短期間で撤退する方が多いのです。<br><br>新陳代謝が激しいということですね。<br><br>例えば、１月に始めた方が100人いるとしましょう。<br>1ヶ月で60人、3ヶ月で80人、6ヶ月後には95人が辞めています。<br>大げさ 
に聞こえるかもしれませんが悲しいことに事実です。。<br><br>後発組でも勝てる理由としては、多くの人の場合、<br>・インプットばかりでそもそも行動を起こしていない人が大多数<br>・いろんなノウハウに手を出してノウハウコレクターになってしまっている<br>・正しい知識がないから結果が出ずにすぐに辞めていく<br>こんな状態に陥ってしまっています。<br><br>ただ、明鏡試遂で学んだ知識を活かして、<br>継続して行動すれば結果は出ます。</p>
</div>
<br style="font-size: medium;"><div class="ctwlpt-block-faq-dt ctwlpt-block-faq-dt-icon-minus" style="margin: 0px; padding: 1em; border: 0px rgb(0, 32, 71); outline: 0px; font-size: 12px; vertical-align: baseline; background: rgb(0, 32, 71); display: flex; align-items: center; font-weight: bold; position: relative; transition: 0.2s; font-family: &quot;Noto Sans JP&quot;, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.016px;">
<span class="ctwlpt-block-faq-f" style="color: rgb(243, 215, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; border: 0px; outline: 0px; font-size: 3em; vertical-align: baseline; background-image: initial; background-position: initial; background-size: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-attachment: initial; background-origin: initial; background-clip: initial; font-family: 游明朝, YuMincho, &quot;Hiragino Mincho ProN&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Mincho Pro&quot;, &quot;ＭＳ 明朝&quot;, serif; display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center; font-weight: 100; line-height: 1; position: relative; top: -3px;">Q</span><div class="ctwlpt-block-faq-f-inner" style="margin: 0px; padding: 0px 0px 0px 1em; border: 0px; outline: 0px; vertical-align: baseline; background: transparent;"><span style="color: rgb(255, 255, 0); font-size: 15px;">実績も実力も魅力も自分にはないと思 
うのですが&hellip;</span></div>
</div>
<div class="ctwlpt-block-faq-dd ctwlpt-block-faq-dd-hide" style="margin: 0px; padding: 2em; border: 0px; outline: 0px; font-size: 12px; vertical-align: baseline; background: rgb(240, 240, 240); font-family: &quot;Noto Sans JP&quot;, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.016px;"><p style="margin-bottom: 0px; padding: 0px; border: 0px; outline: 0px; vertical-align: baseline; background: transparent;">A:全く問題ございません。<br><br>そして、実績・実力・魅力がない方はこの世に存在しません。必ずあります。<br>その言語化、発信への活かし方などについても講座内でお話ししておりますので、安心してご参加ください。</p>
</div>
<br style="font-size: medium;"><div class="ctwlpt-block-faq-dt ctwlpt-block-faq-dt-icon-minus" style="margin: 0px; padding: 1em; border: 0px rgb(0, 32, 71); outline: 0px; font-size: 12px; vertical-align: baseline; background: rgb(0, 32, 71); display: flex; align-items: center; font-weight: bold; position: relative; transition: 0.2s; font-family: &quot;Noto Sans JP&quot;, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.016px;">

違いはなんですか？</span></div>
</div>
<div class="ctwlpt-block-faq-dd ctwlpt-block-faq-dd-hide" style="margin: 0px; padding: 2em; border: 0px; outline: 0px; font-size: 12px; vertical-align: baseline; background: rgb(240, 240, 240); font-family: &quot;Noto Sans JP&quot;, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.016px;"><p style="margin-bottom: 0px; padding: 0px; border: 0px; outline: 0px; vertical-align: baseline; background: transparent;">A:ひとことで言えば「超実践的」です。<br><br>現場で必要なもののみを重点的に完備し、目標達成において遠回りになるもの、<br>今すぐに必要のないもの、成果に直結しづらいものを避けて、<br>最短で売れる仕組みを作るというゴールに辿り着いていただいております。</p>
</div>
<br style="font-size: medium;"><div class="ctwlpt-block-faq-dt ctwlpt-block-faq-dt-icon-minus" style="margin: 0px; padding: 1em; border: 0px rgb(0, 32, 71); outline: 0px; font-size: 12px; vertical-align: baseline; background: rgb(0, 32, 71); display: flex; align-items: center; font-weight: bold; position: relative; transition: 0.2s; font-family: &quot;Noto Sans JP&quot;, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.016px;">

なのでしょうか？</span></div>
</div>
<div class="ctwlpt-block-faq-dd ctwlpt-block-faq-dd-hide" style="margin: 0px; padding: 2em; border: 0px; outline: 0px; font-size: 12px; vertical-align: baseline; background: rgb(240, 240, 240); font-family: &quot;Noto Sans JP&quot;, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.016px;"><p style="margin-bottom: 0px; padding: 0px; border: 0px; outline: 0px; vertical-align: baseline; background: transparent;">A：全く問題ございません。<br><br>初心者の方にこそ、<br>最初から最短ルートで仕組み化まで進めたいただきたいです。</p>
</div>
<br style="font-size: medium;"><div class="ctwlpt-block-faq-dt ctwlpt-block-faq-dt-icon-minus" style="margin: 0px; padding: 1em; border: 0px rgb(0, 32, 71); outline: 0px; font-size: 12px; vertical-align: baseline; background: rgb(0, 32, 71); display: flex; align-items: center; font-weight: bold; position: relative; transition: 0.2s; font-family: &quot;Noto Sans JP&quot;, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.016px;">
<span class="ctwlpt-block-faq-f" style="color: rgb(243, 215, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; border: 0px; outline: 0px; font-size: 3em; vertical-align: baseline; background-image: initial; background-position: initial; background-size: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-attachment: initial; background-origin: initial; background-clip: initial; font-family: 游明朝, YuMincho, &quot;Hiragino Mincho ProN&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Mincho Pro&quot;, &quot;ＭＳ 明朝&quot;, serif; display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center; font-weight: 100; line-height: 1; position: relative; top: -3px;">Q</span><div class="ctwlpt-block-faq-f-inner" style="margin: 0px; padding: 0px 0px 0px 1em; border: 0px; outline: 0px; vertical-align: baseline; background: transparent;"><span style="color: rgb(255, 255, 0); font-size: 15px;">既に少し仕組み化を進めています。そ 
れでも大丈夫ですか？</span></div>
</div>
<div class="ctwlpt-block-faq-dd ctwlpt-block-faq-dd-hide" style="margin: 0px; padding: 2em; border: 0px; outline: 0px; font-size: 12px; vertical-align: baseline; background: rgb(240, 240, 240); font-family: &quot;Noto Sans JP&quot;, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.016px;"><p style="margin-bottom: 0px; padding: 0px; border: 0px; outline: 0px; vertical-align: baseline; background: transparent;">A:大歓迎です。<br><br>お伝えした通り0&rarr;1はもちろん、<br>100以上を目指す方のためのカリキュラムやロードマップ、具体的な施策を完備し、<br>今ある仕組みを変えて、参加後１週間でで大きな売上を出される方もいらっしゃいます。<br>講座でお待ちしております。</p>
</div>
<br style="font-size: medium;"><div class="ctwlpt-block-faq-dt ctwlpt-block-faq-dt-icon-minus" style="margin: 0px; padding: 1em; border: 0px rgb(0, 32, 71); outline: 0px; font-size: 12px; vertical-align: baseline; background: rgb(0, 32, 71); display: flex; align-items: center; font-weight: bold; position: relative; transition: 0.2s; font-family: &quot;Noto Sans JP&quot;, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.016px;">
<span class="ctwlpt-block-faq-f" style="color: rgb(243, 215, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; border: 0px; outline: 0px; font-size: 3em; vertical-align: baseline; background-image: initial; background-position: initial; background-size: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-attachment: initial; background-origin: initial; background-clip: initial; font-family: 游明朝, YuMincho, &quot;Hiragino Mincho ProN&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Mincho Pro&quot;, &quot;ＭＳ 明朝&quot;, serif; display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center; font-weight: 100; line-height: 1; position: relative; top: -3px;">Q</span><div class="ctwlpt-block-faq-f-inner" style="margin: 0px; padding: 0px 0px 0px 1em; border: 0px; outline: 0px; vertical-align: baseline; background: transparent;"><span style="color: rgb(255, 255, 0); font-size: 15px;">ひとことでどんな方向けの講座ですか 
？</span></div>
</div>
<div class="ctwlpt-block-faq-dd ctwlpt-block-faq-dd-hide" style="margin: 0px; padding: 2em; border: 0px; outline: 0px; font-size: 12px; vertical-align: baseline; background: rgb(240, 240, 240); font-family: &quot;Noto Sans JP&quot;, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.016px;"><p style="margin-bottom: 0px; padding: 0px; border: 0px; outline: 0px; vertical-align: baseline; background: transparent;">A:ひとことではちょっと足りないのですが&hellip;<br><br>・これからコンテンツビジネスを始められる方<br>・既にコンテンツは持っていて仕組み化に向けて動き出したい方<br><br>こんな方向けです。</p>
</div>
<br style="font-size: medium;"><div class="ctwlpt-block-faq-dt ctwlpt-block-faq-dt-icon-minus" style="margin: 0px; padding: 1em; border: 0px rgb(0, 32, 71); outline: 0px; font-size: 12px; vertical-align: baseline; background: rgb(0, 32, 71); display: flex; align-items: center; font-weight: bold; position: relative; transition: 0.2s; font-family: &quot;Noto Sans JP&quot;, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.016px;">
<span class="ctwlpt-block-faq-f" style="color: rgb(243, 215, 0); margin: 0px; padding: 0px; border: 0px; outline: 0px; font-size: 3em; vertical-align: baseline; background-image: initial; background-position: initial; background-size: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-attachment: initial; background-origin: initial; background-clip: initial; font-family: 游明朝, YuMincho, &quot;Hiragino Mincho ProN&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Mincho Pro&quot;, &quot;ＭＳ 明朝&quot;, serif; display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center; font-weight: 100; line-height: 1; position: relative; top: -3px;">Q</span><div class="ctwlpt-block-faq-f-inner" style="margin: 0px; padding: 0px 0px 0px 1em; border: 0px; outline: 0px; vertical-align: baseline; background: transparent;"><span style="color: rgb(255, 255, 0); font-size: 15px;">顔出しは必要ですか？</span></div>
</div>
<div class="ctwlpt-block-faq-dd ctwlpt-block-faq-dd-hide" style="margin: 0px; padding: 2em; border: 0px; outline: 0px; font-size: 12px; vertical-align: baseline; background: rgb(240, 240, 240); font-family: &quot;Noto Sans JP&quot;, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.016px;"><p style="margin-bottom: 0px; padding: 0px; border: 0px; outline: 0px; vertical-align: baseline; background: transparent;">A:必要ございません。<br><br>「いや、おんゆー顔出してるじゃん」と思われるかもしれませんが、<br>開始当初は顔出しなしで売上を上げ続けていました。<br><br>私が顔を出したのは気まぐれで、<br>出しても出さなくてもどちらでも良い環境だったというのが大きいです。<br><br>後悔は全くしていませんが、<br>出す必要も特になかったかなと今では思っております。<br>&nbsp;<br>顔
 を出していないから信用されない、なんてことはありません。<br>しっかりと価値が提供できていれば、顔出し無しでも十分収益化できます。<br><br>実際、受講生の方の９割以上が顔出しなしで成果を出されています。<br><br>また、「声で会社や友人・家族にバレるんじゃないか？」<br>という心配もあるかもしれませんが、声だけでバレたという報告は聞いたことがありません。<br><br>バレるとしたら、作業中に見つかるなどそれくらいだと思われます。</p>
</div>

<p class="p1" style="color: rgb(55, 65, 81); margin-bottom: 0px; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 13px; line-height: normal; font-family: &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;;"><br><br><span style="font-size: 16px;">だけど、</span><br><b><span style="font-size: 16px;">自分が思う最悪なケースって</span><br><span style="font-size: 16px;">ほとんど起こらないんですよね。</span></b><br></p>
<p class="p3" style="color: rgb(55, 65, 81); min-height: 15px; margin-bottom: 0px; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 13px; line-height: normal; font-family: &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;;"><br></p>
<p class="p1" style="color: rgb(55, 65, 81); margin-bottom: 0px; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 13px; line-height: normal; font-family: &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;;"><br><br><span style="font-size: 16px;">実際 、</span><span style="font-size: 16px;">僕も起業する前までは 、</span></p>
<p class="p3" style="color: rgb(55, 65, 81); min-height: 15px; margin-bottom: 0px; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 13px; line-height: normal; font-family: &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;;"><br></p>
<p class="p1" style="color: rgb(55, 65, 81); margin-bottom: 0px; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 13px; line-height: normal; font-family: &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;;"><br><b><span style="font-size: 16px;">「失敗したら借金して</span><br><span style="font-size: 16px;">　ヤクザが家に取り立てに来るのでは？」</span></b><b></b></p>
<p class="p3" style="color: rgb(55, 65, 81); min-height: 15px; margin-bottom: 0px; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 13px; line-height: normal; font-family: &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;;"><br></p>
<p class="p1" style="color: rgb(55, 65, 81); margin-bottom: 0px; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 13px; line-height: normal; font-family: &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;;"><br><span style="font-size: 16px;">と本気で思っていましたが、</span><br><span style="font-size: 16px;">そんな事は全くありませんでした（笑）</span></p>
<p class="p3" style="color: rgb(55, 65, 81); min-height: 15px; margin-bottom: 0px; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 13px; line-height: normal; font-family: &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;;"><br></p>
<p class="p3" style="color: rgb(55, 65, 81); min-height: 15px; margin-bottom: 0px; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 13px; line-height: normal; font-family: &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;;"><br></p>
<p class="p1" style="color: rgb(55, 65, 81); margin-bottom: 0px; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 13px; line-height: normal; font-family: &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;;"><br><br><span style="font-size: 16px;">そもそもコンテンツビジネ スは 、</span><br><span style="font-size: 16px;">必要なお金が１０万円もしないので、</span><br><span style="font-size: 16px;">失敗しても借金しないです。</span></p>
<p class="p3" style="color: rgb(55, 65, 81); min-height: 15px; margin-bottom: 0px; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 13px; line-height: normal; font-family: &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;;"><br></p>
<p class="p1" style="color: rgb(55, 65, 81); margin-bottom: 0px; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 13px; line-height: normal; font-family: &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;;"><br><br><span style="font-size: 16px;">数ヶ月バイトしたら</span><br><span style="font-size: 16px;">取り戻す事ができます。</span><br><br><br><br><span style="font-size: 16px;">逆に起業をしたら、</span><br><span style="font-size: 16px;">良い事しかなかったです。</span><br></p>
<p class="p3" style="color: rgb(55, 65, 81); min-height: 15px; margin-bottom: 0px; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 13px; line-height: normal; font-family: &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;;"><br></p>
<p class="p3" style="color: rgb(55, 65, 81); min-height: 15px; margin-bottom: 0px; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 13px; line-height: normal; font-family: &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;;"><br></p>
<p class="p1" style="color: rgb(55, 65, 81); margin-bottom: 0px; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 13px; line-height: normal; font-family: &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;;"><br><span style="font-size: 16px;">例えば、</span><br><span style="font-size: 16px;">僕は睡眠が好きなのですが、</span></p>
<p class="p3" style="color: rgb(55, 65, 81); min-height: 15px; margin-bottom: 0px; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 13px; line-height: normal; font-family: &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;;"><br></p>
<p class="p1" style="color: rgb(55, 65, 81); margin-bottom: 0px; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 13px; line-height: normal; font-family: &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;;"><br><span style="font-size: 16px;">時間に縛られないコンテンツビジネスは、</span><br><span style="font-size: 16px;">いつまでも寝ていられます。</span><br></p>
<p class="p3" style="color: rgb(55, 65, 81); min-height: 15px; margin-bottom: 0px; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 13px; line-height: normal; font-family: &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;;"><br></p>
<p class="p1" style="color: rgb(55, 65, 81); margin-bottom: 0px; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 13px; line-height: normal; font-family: &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;;"><br><span style="font-size: 16px;">なので、</span><span style="font-size: 16px;">無理して起きる必要はなく</span><br><span style="font-size: 16px;">10時ごろまでグッスリ。</span><br><br><span style="font-size: 16px;">しっかり睡眠が取れます。</span><br><br><br><br><span style="font-size: 16px;">目覚まし時計に起こされて</span><br><span style="font-size: 16px;">うなされる事もありませ 
ん。</span><br></p>
<p class="p1" style="color: rgb(55, 65, 81); margin-bottom: 0px; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 13px; line-height: normal; font-family: &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;;"><span style="font-size: 16px;">&nbsp;</span></p>
<p class="p1" style="color: rgb(55, 65, 81); margin-bottom: 0px; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 13px; line-height: normal; font-family: &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;;"><br><br><span style="font-size: 16px;">他には、</span><span style="font-size: 16px;">僕が大学1年の時にやったのですが、</span><br><span style="font-size: 16px;">毎日ラーメンを食べることも出来ました。</span></p>
<p class="p3" style="color: rgb(55, 65, 81); min-height: 15px; margin-bottom: 0px; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 13px; line-height: normal; font-family: &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;;">（今思うとチョイスが謎すぎる）</p>
<p class="p1" style="color: rgb(55, 65, 81); margin-bottom: 0px; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: medium; line-height: normal; font-family: &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;;"><br><br><span style="font-size: 16px;">大学1年生の時、</span><br><span style="font-size: 16px;">「町田商店」という</span><br><span style="font-size: 16px;">家系ラーメン屋にハマりました。</span><br><br><br><br>仕組み化してから、<br><span style="font-size: 16px;">好きなだけラーメンを食べれるようになり、</span><br><span style="font-size: 16px;">3週間毎日大学帰りに行って
ました。</span><br></p>
<p class="p3" style="color: rgb(55, 65, 81); min-height: 15px; margin-bottom: 0px; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 13px; line-height: normal; font-family: &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;;"><br></p>
<p class="p1" style="color: rgb(55, 65, 81); margin-bottom: 0px; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 13px; line-height: normal; font-family: &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;;"><br><span style="font-size: 16px;">そのおかげで数ヶ月間はラーメンが</span><br><span style="font-size: 16px;">あまり好きじゃなくなってしまいましたが&hellip;</span><br><br><br><br><br><span style="font-size: 16px;">そんな話はさておき、</span><br><span style="font-size: 16px;">行動を起こすことで</span><br><span style="font-size: 16px;">このような生活を手に入れられるのです。
</span></p>
<p class="p1" style="color: rgb(55, 65, 81); margin-bottom: 0px; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 13px; line-height: normal; font-family: &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;;"><br><br><br><br><span style="font-size: 16px;">実際、僕のクライアントは、</span><br><span style="font-size: 16px;">毎月売上が安定して出るようになったことで</span><br><span style="font-size: 16px;">自信が付いたそうです。</span></p>
<p class="p1" style="color: rgb(55, 65, 81); margin-bottom: 0px; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 13px; line-height: normal; font-family: &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;;"><span style="font-size: 16px;">&nbsp;</span></p>
<p class="p1" style="color: rgb(55, 65, 81); margin-bottom: 0px; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 13px; line-height: normal; font-family: &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;;"><br><br><span style="font-size: 16px;">そして、</span><span style="font-size: 16px;">ポジティブな思考に変わり、</span></p>
<p class="p1" style="color: rgb(55, 65, 81); margin-bottom: 0px; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 13px; line-height: normal; font-family: &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;;"><br><span style="font-size: 16px;">前から好きだった女性に告白した結果、</span><br><span style="font-size: 16px;">付き合う事ができました。</span><br><br><br><br><br><b><span style="font-size: 16px;">これも全て行動したからこそ</span><br><span style="font-size: 16px;">生まれた結果です。</span><br></b><b></b></p>
<p class="p3" style="color: rgb(55, 65, 81); min-height: 15px; margin-bottom: 0px; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 13px; line-height: normal; font-family: &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;;"><br></p>
<p class="p1" style="color: rgb(55, 65, 81); margin-bottom: 0px; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 13px; line-height: normal; font-family: &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;;"><br><br><span style="font-size: 16px;">本当に日本人は、</span><br><b><span style="font-size: 16px;">ネガティブな思考の人が多すぎる</span></b><span style="font-size: 16px;">と、</span><br><span style="font-size: 16px;">僕は思います。</span><br></p>
<p class="p3" style="color: rgb(55, 65, 81); min-height: 15px; margin-bottom: 0px; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 13px; line-height: normal; font-family: &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;;"><br></p>
<p class="p1" style="color: rgb(55, 65, 81); margin-bottom: 0px; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 13px; line-height: normal; font-family: &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;;"><br><br><b><span style="font-size: 16px;">もう少しポジティブに物事を</span><br><span style="font-size: 16px;">考えていきましょう。</span></b><br></p>
<p class="p1" style="color: rgb(55, 65, 81); margin-bottom: 0px; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 13px; line-height: normal; font-family: &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;;"><span style="font-size: 16px;">&nbsp;</span></p>
<p class="p1" style="color: rgb(55, 65, 81); margin-bottom: 0px; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 13px; line-height: normal; font-family: &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;;"><br><span style="font-size: 16px;">そうするだけで</span><br><span style="font-size: 16px;">思い描く理想の人生を送れるようになります。</span><br></p>
<p class="p1" style="color: rgb(55, 65, 81); margin-bottom: 0px; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 13px; line-height: normal; font-family: &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;;"><span style="font-size: 16px;">&nbsp;</span></p>

<span class="s1" style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 13px; line-height: normal;"><br></span><b>２　日本がアメリカよりも</b><span class="s1" style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 13px; line-height: normal;"><b><br></b></span><b>　　自由になりやすい理由</b>
<span class="s1" style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 13px; line-height: normal;"><br></span><b>＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝</b><span class="s1" style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 13px; line-height: normal;"><br></span></p>

<p class="p3" style="color: rgb(55, 65, 81); min-height: 15px; margin-bottom: 0px; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 13px; line-height: normal; font-family: &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;;"><br></p>

<p class="p3" style="color: rgb(55, 65, 81); min-height: 15px; margin-bottom: 0px; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 13px; line-height: normal; font-family: &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;;"><br></p>

<span class="s3" style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 16px; line-height: normal;"><b>&rdquo;敵&rdquo;</b></span><span class="s2" style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 16px; line-height: normal;"><b>にすらなりません。</b></span><br><br></p>

 退社会である日本 が</span><span class="s1" style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; font-stretch: normal; line-height: normal; font-family: &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;;"><br></span><span style="font-size: 16px;">いつ崩壊するかわかりませんからね。</span>

<p class="p1" style="color: rgb(55, 65, 81); margin-bottom: 0px; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 13px; line-height: normal; font-family: &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;;"><br><span style="font-size: 16px;">でも、</span><span style="font-size: 16px;">自分で行動したから</span><br><span style="font-size: 16px;">幸せな生活を手に入れられたのです。</span></p>
<p class="p3" style="color: rgb(55, 65, 81); min-height: 15px; margin-bottom: 0px; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 13px; line-height: normal; font-family: &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;;"><br></p>
<p class="p2" style="color: rgb(55, 65, 81); margin-bottom: 0px; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; font-stretch: normal; line-height: normal; font-family: &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;;"><span class="s1" style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 13px; line-height: normal;"><br><br><br></span><b>僕たちは、</b>
<span class="s1" style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 13px; line-height: normal;"><b><br></b></span><b>失敗を恐れます。</b><span class="s1" style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 13px; line-height: normal;"><br></span></p>
<p class="p3" style="color: rgb(55, 65, 81); min-height: 15px; margin-bottom: 0px; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 13px; line-height: normal; font-family: &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;;"><br></p>
<p class="p3" style="color: rgb(55, 65, 81); min-height: 15px; margin-bottom: 0px; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 13px; line-height: normal; font-family: &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;;"><br></p>
<p class="p2" style="color: rgb(55, 65, 81); margin-bottom: 0px; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; font-stretch: normal; line-height: normal; font-family: &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;;"><span class="s1" style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 13px; line-height: normal;"><br></span><b>起業して失敗し たらどうしよう。</b><b></b></p>
<p class="p3" style="color: rgb(55, 65, 81); min-height: 15px; margin-bottom: 0px; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 13px; line-height: normal; font-family: &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;;"><br></p>
<p class="p2" style="color: rgb(55, 65, 81); margin-bottom: 0px; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; font-stretch: normal; line-height: normal; font-family: &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;;"><span class="s1" style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 13px; line-height: normal;"><b><br></b></span><b>この人を信 頼しても良いのか な。</b><b></b></p>
<p class="p3" style="color: rgb(55, 65, 81); min-height: 15px; margin-bottom: 0px; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 13px; line-height: normal; font-family: &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;;"><br></p>
