<span style="font-weight: bold;">自分の勝ちパターンを見逃さないよう
上手くいった原因を正確に特定して擦る。
</span>

</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 17px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;"></span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 17px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;"></span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 17px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;">

もちろん逆もシカり。


</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 17px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;"></span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 17px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;"></span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 17px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;">

例えば、
<span style="font-weight: bold;">「レターからの売上が微妙だなぁ」</span>
という時に、



</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 17px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;"></span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 17px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;"></span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 17px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;">
<span style="font-weight: bold;">ヘッドコピー？オファーが微妙？
問題提起が刺さってない？
本文のライティング？
ページのデザイン？
セールスレター全体的に悪いんかな？
そもそも商品のコンセプトから刺さらなくなった？
</span>

</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 17px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;"></span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 17px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;">
とか色々考えますよね。


</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 17px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;"></span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 17px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;"></span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 17px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;">

で、
ここでちゃんとこれまでの数値を取ってたら、

</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 17px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;"></span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 17px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;">
メールからの開封率が低いとか、
リンククリック率が低いとか、
大前提そもそもリストを取れていなかったり、



</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 17px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;"></span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 17px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;"></span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 17px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;"><span style="font-weight: bold; color: rgb(156, 0, 0);">
「原因はシンプルに集客不足で
セールスの場まで到達する数が少なかった。」</span>



</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 17px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;"></span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 17px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;">
と原因をすぐに突き止めて、
セールスレターどうこう以前の問題だった
ということがわかります。

(レターに問題があると思いがち)



</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 17px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;"></span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 17px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;">
レターを修正して、
多少は成約率は上がるかもしれないけど
ほぼ誤差レベル。

</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 17px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;"></span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 17px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;">

優先度の高いタスクは
集客数やオファーまでの期間の見直し、
離脱ポイントの特定ということです。


</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 17px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;"></span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 17px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;"></span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 17px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;"></span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 17px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;">

他にも、
<span style="font-weight: bold;">「コンテンツから導線への入りが悪いなぁ」</span>
という時に色々イジりたくなりますが、



</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 17px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;"></span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 17px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;"></span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 17px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;">
一番大きな原因はシンプルに
<span style="font-weight: bold;">「コンテンツの内容が
あまり刺さっていないからその後に進まない」</span>
なんてことも多々あります。



</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 17px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;"></span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 17px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;"></span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 17px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;">
逆に、
「これは上手くいった！」「調子いいな」
ということがあったとして、
</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 17px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;">
要因を探って、
とりあえず同じことをしようとします。



</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 17px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;"></span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 17px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;"></span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 17px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;">
本当は&ldquo;それ&rdquo;が要因で
上手くいっているわけではないのに、


</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 17px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;"></span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 17px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;"></span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 17px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;">早々に断定して、
&rarr;関係のないところを擦る
&rarr;たまたまだったのかなぁ
</span><span style="background-color: inherit; font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 17px; white-space-collapse: preserve;">&rarr;勝ちパターン消失
&rarr;元に戻る
&rarr;迷走</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 17px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;">
</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 17px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;">
なんてこともあります。



</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 17px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;"></span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 17px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;"></span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 17px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;">
<span style="font-weight: bold; color: rgb(156, 0, 0);">擦るところを間違えない。正確に見抜く。</span>
これめっちゃ大事です。



</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 17px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;"></span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 17px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;"></span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 17px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;"></span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 17px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;">
そして、最終的には、
<span style="font-weight: bold; color: rgb(156, 0, 0);">「再現可能な勝ちパターン」</span>を
いくつ持てているかが勝負かなぁと。




</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 17px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;"></span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 17px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;"></span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 17px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;"></span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 17px; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: inherit;">
<span style="font-weight: bold;">「再現可能な勝ちパターン」
の言語化には数値管理は必須です。</span>
<br></span></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><br><br></p>
<p>ではでは&#12316;TGIF!!<br><br><br></p>

<p class="p1" style="margin-bottom: 0px; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 17px; line-height: normal; font-family: &quot;.AppleSystemUIFont&quot;;"><span class="s1" style="font-family: UICTFontTextStyleBody; font-weight: bold;">2つの価格の合計よりも安く販売する。</span></p>
<p class="p2" style="margin-bottom: 0px; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 17px; line-height: normal; font-family: &quot;.AppleSystemUIFont&quot;; min-height: 22px;"><span class="s1" style="font-family: UICTFontTextStyleBody;"></span><br><br><br></p>
<p class="p2" style="margin-bottom: 0px; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 17px; line-height: normal; font-family: &quot;.AppleSystemUIFont&quot;; min-height: 22px;">&nbsp;</p>
<p class="p2" style="margin-bottom: 0px; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 17px; line-height: normal; font-family: &quot;.AppleSystemUIFont&quot;; min-height: 22px;"><br></p>
<p class="p1" style="margin-bottom: 0px; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 17px; line-height: normal; font-family: &quot;.AppleSystemUIFont&quot;;"><span class="s1" style="font-family: UICTFontTextStyleBody;">もちろんセットは、</span></p>
<p class="p1" style="margin-bottom: 0px; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 17px; line-height: normal; font-family: &quot;.AppleSystemUIFont&quot;;"><span class="s1" style="font-family: UICTFontTextStyleBody;">追加内容や特典も全てコミコミです。</span></p>
<p class="p2" style="margin-bottom: 0px; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 17px; line-height: normal; font-family: &quot;.AppleSystemUIFont&quot;; min-height: 22px;"><span class="s1" style="font-family: UICTFontTextStyleBody;"></span><br><br><br></p>
<p class="p2" style="margin-bottom: 0px; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 17px; line-height: normal; font-family: &quot;.AppleSystemUIFont&quot;; min-height: 22px;">&nbsp;</p>
<p class="p2" style="margin-bottom: 0px; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 17px; line-height: normal; font-family: &quot;.AppleSystemUIFont&quot;; min-height: 22px;"><br></p>
<p class="p1" style="margin-bottom: 0px; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 17px; line-height: normal;"><span style="font-family: UICTFontTextStyleBody;">コレが</span></p>
<p class="p1" style="margin-bottom: 0px; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 17px; line-height: normal; font-family: &quot;.AppleSystemUIFont&quot;;"><span class="s1" style="font-family: UICTFontTextStyleBody;">「1度に2つのコンテンツを作る方法」</span></p>
<p class="p2" style="margin-bottom: 0px; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 17px; line-height: normal; font-family: &quot;.AppleSystemUIFont&quot;; min-height: 22px;"><span class="s1" style="font-family: UICTFontTextStyleBody;"></span><br></p>
<p class="p1" style="margin-bottom: 0px; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 17px; line-height: normal; font-family: &quot;.AppleSystemUIFont&quot;;"><br></p>
<p class="p2" style="margin-bottom: 0px; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 17px; line-height: normal; font-family: &quot;.AppleSystemUIFont&quot;; min-height: 22px;"><span class="s1" style="font-family: UICTFontTextStyleBody;"></span><br></p>
<p class="p1" style="margin-bottom: 0px; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 17px; line-height: normal; font-family: &quot;.AppleSystemUIFont&quot;;"><span class="s1" style="font-family: UICTFontTextStyleBody;">ちなみに、</span></p>
<p class="p1" style="margin-bottom: 0px; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 17px; line-height: normal; font-family: &quot;.AppleSystemUIFont&quot;;"><span class="s1" style="font-family: UICTFontTextStyleBody;">「強いオファーって言ってたけど、</span></p>
<p class="p1" style="margin-bottom: 0px; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 17px; line-height: normal; font-family: &quot;.AppleSystemUIFont&quot;;"><span class="s1" style="font-family: UICTFontTextStyleBody;">高い方の写真を買ったの？」</span></p>
<p class="p2" style="margin-bottom: 0px; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 17px; line-height: normal; font-family: &quot;.AppleSystemUIFont&quot;; min-height: 22px;"><span class="s1" style="font-family: UICTFontTextStyleBody;"></span><br><br><br></p>
<p class="p2" style="margin-bottom: 0px; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 17px; line-height: normal; font-family: &quot;.AppleSystemUIFont&quot;; min-height: 22px;">&nbsp;</p>
<p class="p2" style="margin-bottom: 0px; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 17px; line-height: normal; font-family: &quot;.AppleSystemUIFont&quot;; min-height: 22px;"><br></p>
<p class="p1" style="margin-bottom: 0px; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 17px; line-height: normal; font-family: &quot;.AppleSystemUIFont&quot;;"><span class="s1" style="font-family: UICTFontTextStyleBody;">&rarr;買ってません。</span></p>
<p class="p2" style="margin-bottom: 0px; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 17px; line-height: normal; font-family: &quot;.AppleSystemUIFont&quot;; min-height: 22px;"><span class="s1" style="font-family: UICTFontTextStyleBody;"></span><br><br><br></p>
<p class="p2" style="margin-bottom: 0px; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 17px; line-height: normal; font-family: &quot;.AppleSystemUIFont&quot;; min-height: 22px;"><br></p>
<p class="p1" style="margin-bottom: 0px; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 17px; line-height: normal; font-family: &quot;.AppleSystemUIFont&quot;;"><span class="s1" style="font-family: UICTFontTextStyleBody;">パートナーに</span></p>
<p class="p1" style="margin-bottom: 0px; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 17px; line-height: normal; font-family: &quot;.AppleSystemUIFont&quot;;"><span class="s1" style="font-family: UICTFontTextStyleBody;">「私の写り悪いからいらない」</span></p>
<p class="p1" style="margin-bottom: 0px; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 17px; line-height: normal; font-family: &quot;.AppleSystemUIFont&quot;;"><span class="s1" style="font-family: UICTFontTextStyleBody;">って言われたので買いませんでした...</span></p>
<p class="p2" style="margin-bottom: 0px; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 17px; line-height: normal; font-family: &quot;.AppleSystemUIFont&quot;; min-height: 22px;"><span class="s1" style="font-family: UICTFontTextStyleBody;"></span><br></p>
<p><span style="font-family: UICTFontTextStyleBody; font-size: 17px;">大きい写真欲しかった。。。</span></p>

<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><img src="%url2%{https://onyou24600720.com/sp/8LX86pOd/Nlwr1Dgi/images/hnew.png}" width="600px" height="200px"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><br></p>
<p>%name2%さんこんばんは<br>おんゆーです。<br><br><br></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>お盆はいかがでしたか？</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><br><br></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>僕は黒部ダムに行ってきたんですが、<br>そこで<b>「これされたら買うしかないやん...」</b><br>みたいな経験をしたので<br><br></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>近々記事を書こうと思います（笑）<br><br></p>
<p><br></p>
<p>さて、今日の本題です。</p>
<p><br></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>「上手くいったモノは擦り倒せ」</p>
<p><br></p>
<p>って、よく言われます。</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><a href="%url3%{https://x.com/nishishi0720/status/1825438999567327742?s=46&t=u8VF6bAACzGGKTBZAfmDNQ}" class="docs-creator"><img src="%url4%{https://onyou24600720.com/sp/8LX86pOd/Nlwr1Dgi/images/amazn3.png}" width="600px" height="150px"></a><br></p>
<p><br></p>
<p>僕自身よく言ってますし、</p>
<p>実際に擦り倒してます。</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><br><br></p>
<p><br></p>
<p>初めのうちは上手く横展開できて</p>
<p>順調にいくんですけど、</p>
<p><br></p>
<p>途端に上手くいかなる&ldquo;現象&rdquo;があります。</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><br><br></p>
<p><br></p>
<p>もちろん、一過性の手段だったり</p>
<p>「トレンドだったから</p>
<p>今は上手くいかないだけだ」</p>
<p><br></p>
<p>と片付けることもできますが</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><br><br></p>
<p><br></p>
<p>それは表面的に擦っているだけなので、</p>
<p>なぜ上手くいったのかを<br>正しく言語化できていない状態です。</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><br></p>
<p><br></p>
<p>で、その言語化も済んでいて、</p>
<p><br></p>
<p>どこを擦れば上手くいくのかを</p>
<p>正確に把握していたとしても起きる</p>
<p>&ldquo;現象&rdquo;の正体は...</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><br><br></p>
<p><br></p>
<p>『飽き』です。</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><br><br></p>
<p><br></p>
<p>自分で自分の発信内容に飽きてきます。</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><br><br></p>
<p><br></p>
<p>お笑い芸人が一発当たった芸を</p>
<p>ある日とつぜん封印する&ldquo;アノ現象&rdquo;です。</p>
<p><b></b></p>
<p><b></b></p>
<p><b><br><br></b></p>
<p><b><br></b></p>
<p><b>「自分が飽きてきたんだから、</b></p>
<p><b>見てる人も飽きてるでしょ」</b></p>
<p><br></p>
<p>と勝手に正当化してやめてしまう。</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><br><br></p>
<p><br></p>
<p>そして、新たな当たりを探し続けて、</p>
<p>迷走し始める....</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><br><br></p>
<p><br></p>
<p>めちゃくちゃ勿体無いです。</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><br><br></p>
<p><br></p>
<p>やれば上手くいくとわかっているのに</p>
<p>なぜか避けて、</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><br><br></p>
<p><br></p>
<p>「同じ手法ではダメだ。</p>
<p>新しいことをしないと」</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><br><br></p>
<p><br></p>
<p>と正当化しちゃってるんですね。</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><br><br><br></p>
<p><br></p>
<p>もちろん、新しいこともやるんですが、</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><br></p>
<p>手札を捨てて新しいカードを得るのか</p>
<p>2枚目、3枚目と強力なカードを追加していくのか</p>
<p><br><br></p>
<p><br></p>
<p>前者と後者では結果が全く変わってきます。</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><br><br></p>
<p><br></p>
<p>前者はゲームでいうところの</p>
<p>「リセマラ」を延々としてる状態ですね(笑)</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><br><br></p>
<p><br></p>
<p>自分の芸に自分で飽きちゃダメです。</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><br></p>
<p><br></p>
<p>ではでは&#12316;</p>
<p><br><br><br><br></p>
<p><span style="white-space-collapse: preserve; font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px;"><b>＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝</b></span></p>
<p><b>%name2%さんの累計ポイント&darr;<br><span style="white-space-collapse: preserve; font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px;">
</span>%point%ポイント<br><span style="white-space-collapse: preserve; font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px;">
</span><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve;">＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝</span></b></p>
<p><br></p>

<p><font style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255);"><span class="css-1jxf684 r-bcqeeo r-1ttztb7 r-qvutc0 r-1tl8opc" style="border: 0px solid black; display: inline; font-variant-numeric: inherit; font-variant-east-asian: inherit; font-variant-alternates: inherit; font-variant-position: inherit; font-stretch: inherit; font-size: 16px; line-height: inherit; font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif; font-optical-sizing: inherit; font-size-adjust: inherit; font-kerning: inherit; font-feature-settings: inherit; font-variation-settings: inherit; list-style: none; margin: 0px; padding: 0px; position: relative; white-space-collapse: preserve; overflow-wrap: break-word; min-width: 0px; text-overflow: unset; background-color: inherit;">

</span></font></p>
<p><font style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255);"><span class="css-1jxf684 r-bcqeeo r-1ttztb7 r-qvutc0 r-1tl8opc" style="border: 0px solid black; display: inline; font-variant-numeric: inherit; font-variant-east-asian: inherit; font-variant-alternates: inherit; font-variant-position: inherit; font-stretch: inherit; font-size: 16px; line-height: inherit; font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif; font-optical-sizing: inherit; font-size-adjust: inherit; font-kerning: inherit; font-feature-settings: inherit; font-variation-settings: inherit; list-style: none; margin: 0px; padding: 0px; position: relative; white-space-collapse: preserve; overflow-wrap: break-word; min-width: 0px; text-overflow: unset; background-color: inherit;">

コンテンツ販売が切り口であれば
コンセプトの軸が一致してるので
市場の教育も相まってリテラシーも比較的高く、</span></font></p>
<p><font style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255);"><span class="css-1jxf684 r-bcqeeo r-1ttztb7 r-qvutc0 r-1tl8opc" style="border: 0px solid black; display: inline; font-variant-numeric: inherit; font-variant-east-asian: inherit; font-variant-alternates: inherit; font-variant-position: inherit; font-stretch: inherit; font-size: 16px; line-height: inherit; font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif; font-optical-sizing: inherit; font-size-adjust: inherit; font-kerning: inherit; font-feature-settings: inherit; font-variation-settings: inherit; list-style: none; margin: 0px; padding: 0px; position: relative; white-space-collapse: preserve; overflow-wrap: break-word; min-width: 0px; text-overflow: unset; background-color: inherit;"></span></font></p>
<p><font style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255);"><span class="css-1jxf684 r-bcqeeo r-1ttztb7 r-qvutc0 r-1tl8opc" style="border: 0px solid black; display: inline; font-variant-numeric: inherit; font-variant-east-asian: inherit; font-variant-alternates: inherit; font-variant-position: inherit; font-stretch: inherit; font-size: 16px; line-height: inherit; font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif; font-optical-sizing: inherit; font-size-adjust: inherit; font-kerning: inherit; font-feature-settings: inherit; font-variation-settings: inherit; list-style: none; margin: 0px; padding: 0px; position: relative; white-space-collapse: preserve; overflow-wrap: break-word; min-width: 0px; text-overflow: unset; background-color: inherit;">

</span></font></p>
<p><font style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255);"><span class="css-1jxf684 r-bcqeeo r-1ttztb7 r-qvutc0 r-1tl8opc" style="border: 0px solid black; display: inline; font-variant-numeric: inherit; font-variant-east-asian: inherit; font-variant-alternates: inherit; font-variant-position: inherit; font-stretch: inherit; font-size: 16px; line-height: inherit; font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif; font-optical-sizing: inherit; font-size-adjust: inherit; font-kerning: inherit; font-feature-settings: inherit; font-variation-settings: inherit; list-style: none; margin: 0px; padding: 0px; position: relative; white-space-collapse: preserve; overflow-wrap: break-word; min-width: 0px; text-overflow: unset; background-color: inherit;">

顕在層が多めです。</span></font></p>
<p><font style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255);"><span class="css-1jxf684 r-bcqeeo r-1ttztb7 r-qvutc0 r-1tl8opc" style="border: 0px solid black; display: inline; font-variant-numeric: inherit; font-variant-east-asian: inherit; font-variant-alternates: inherit; font-variant-position: inherit; font-stretch: inherit; font-size: 16px; line-height: inherit; font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif; font-optical-sizing: inherit; font-size-adjust: inherit; font-kerning: inherit; font-feature-settings: inherit; font-variation-settings: inherit; list-style: none; margin: 0px; padding: 0px; position: relative; white-space-collapse: preserve; overflow-wrap: break-word; min-width: 0px; text-overflow: unset; background-color: inherit;"></span></font></p>
<p><font style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255);"><span class="css-1jxf684 r-bcqeeo r-1ttztb7 r-qvutc0 r-1tl8opc" style="border: 0px solid black; display: inline; font-variant-numeric: inherit; font-variant-east-asian: inherit; font-variant-alternates: inherit; font-variant-position: inherit; font-stretch: inherit; font-size: 16px; line-height: inherit; font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif; font-optical-sizing: inherit; font-size-adjust: inherit; font-kerning: inherit; font-feature-settings: inherit; font-variation-settings: inherit; list-style: none; margin: 0px; padding: 0px; position: relative; white-space-collapse: preserve; overflow-wrap: break-word; min-width: 0px; text-overflow: unset; background-color: inherit;"></span></font></p>
<p><font style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255);"><span class="css-1jxf684 r-bcqeeo r-1ttztb7 r-qvutc0 r-1tl8opc" style="border: 0px solid black; display: inline; font-variant-numeric: inherit; font-variant-east-asian: inherit; font-variant-alternates: inherit; font-variant-position: inherit; font-stretch: inherit; font-size: 16px; line-height: inherit; font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif; font-optical-sizing: inherit; font-size-adjust: inherit; font-kerning: inherit; font-feature-settings: inherit; font-variation-settings: inherit; list-style: none; margin: 0px; padding: 0px; position: relative; white-space-collapse: preserve; overflow-wrap: break-word; min-width: 0px; text-overflow: unset; background-color: inherit;">
</span></font></p>
<p><font style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255);"><span class="css-1jxf684 r-bcqeeo r-1ttztb7 r-qvutc0 r-1tl8opc" style="border: 0px solid black; display: inline; font-variant-numeric: inherit; font-variant-east-asian: inherit; font-variant-alternates: inherit; font-variant-position: inherit; font-stretch: inherit; font-size: 16px; line-height: inherit; font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif; font-optical-sizing: inherit; font-size-adjust: inherit; font-kerning: inherit; font-feature-settings: inherit; font-variation-settings: inherit; list-style: none; margin: 0px; padding: 0px; position: relative; white-space-collapse: preserve; overflow-wrap: break-word; min-width: 0px; text-overflow: unset; background-color: inherit;">

競合の単価感については
書くと長くなってしまうのでまたの機会に....</span></font></p>
<p><font style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255);"><span class="css-1jxf684 r-bcqeeo r-1ttztb7 r-qvutc0 r-1tl8opc" style="border: 0px solid black; display: inline; font-variant-numeric: inherit; font-variant-east-asian: inherit; font-variant-alternates: inherit; font-variant-position: inherit; font-stretch: inherit; font-size: 16px; line-height: inherit; font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif; font-optical-sizing: inherit; font-size-adjust: inherit; font-kerning: inherit; font-feature-settings: inherit; font-variation-settings: inherit; list-style: none; margin: 0px; padding: 0px; position: relative; white-space-collapse: preserve; overflow-wrap: break-word; min-width: 0px; text-overflow: unset; background-color: inherit;">
</span></font></p>
<p><font style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255);"><span class="css-1jxf684 r-bcqeeo r-1ttztb7 r-qvutc0 r-1tl8opc" style="border: 0px solid black; display: inline; font-variant-numeric: inherit; font-variant-east-asian: inherit; font-variant-alternates: inherit; font-variant-position: inherit; font-stretch: inherit; font-size: 16px; line-height: inherit; font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif; font-optical-sizing: inherit; font-size-adjust: inherit; font-kerning: inherit; font-feature-settings: inherit; font-variation-settings: inherit; list-style: none; margin: 0px; padding: 0px; position: relative; white-space-collapse: preserve; overflow-wrap: break-word; min-width: 0px; text-overflow: unset; background-color: inherit;">
<span style="font-weight: bold;">
まとめると</span>
</span></font></p>
<p><font style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255);"><span class="css-1jxf684 r-bcqeeo r-1ttztb7 r-qvutc0 r-1tl8opc" style="border: 0px solid black; display: inline; font-variant-numeric: inherit; font-variant-east-asian: inherit; font-variant-alternates: inherit; font-variant-position: inherit; font-stretch: inherit; font-size: 16px; line-height: inherit; font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif; font-optical-sizing: inherit; font-size-adjust: inherit; font-kerning: inherit; font-feature-settings: inherit; font-variation-settings: inherit; list-style: none; margin: 0px; padding: 0px; position: relative; white-space-collapse: preserve; overflow-wrap: break-word; min-width: 0px; text-overflow: unset; background-color: inherit;"></span></font></p>

</span></font></p>
<p><font style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255);"><span class="css-1jxf684 r-bcqeeo r-1ttztb7 r-qvutc0 r-1tl8opc" style="border: 0px solid black; display: inline; font-variant-numeric: inherit; font-variant-east-asian: inherit; font-variant-alternates: inherit; font-variant-position: inherit; font-stretch: inherit; font-size: 16px; line-height: inherit; font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif; font-optical-sizing: inherit; font-size-adjust: inherit; font-kerning: inherit; font-feature-settings: inherit; font-variation-settings: inherit; list-style: none; margin: 0px; padding: 0px; position: relative; white-space-collapse: preserve; overflow-wrap: break-word; min-width: 0px; text-overflow: unset; background-color: inherit;">
・<span style="font-weight: bold; color: rgb(8, 82, 148);">前者は広くリーチするので</span></span></font></p>
<p><font style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255);"><span class="css-1jxf684 r-bcqeeo r-1ttztb7 r-qvutc0 r-1tl8opc" style="border: 0px solid black; display: inline; font-variant-numeric: inherit; font-variant-east-asian: inherit; font-variant-alternates: inherit; font-variant-position: inherit; font-stretch: inherit; font-size: 16px; line-height: inherit; font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif; font-optical-sizing: inherit; font-size-adjust: inherit; font-kerning: inherit; font-feature-settings: inherit; font-variation-settings: inherit; list-style: none; margin: 0px; padding: 0px; position: relative; white-space-collapse: preserve; overflow-wrap: break-word; min-width: 0px; text-overflow: unset; background-color: inherit; font-weight: bold; color: rgb(8, 82, 148);">潜在層も多く取ることになり

<p><font style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255);"><span class="css-1jxf684 r-bcqeeo r-1ttztb7 r-qvutc0 r-1tl8opc" style="border: 0px solid black; display: inline; font-variant-numeric: inherit; font-variant-east-asian: inherit; font-variant-alternates: inherit; font-variant-position: inherit; font-stretch: inherit; font-size: 16px; line-height: inherit; font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif; font-optical-sizing: inherit; font-size-adjust: inherit; font-kerning: inherit; font-feature-settings: inherit; font-variation-settings: inherit; list-style: none; margin: 0px; padding: 0px; position: relative; white-space-collapse: preserve; overflow-wrap: break-word; min-width: 0px; text-overflow: unset; background-color: inherit;"></span></font></p>

</span></font></p>
<p><font style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255);"><span class="css-1jxf684 r-bcqeeo r-1ttztb7 r-qvutc0 r-1tl8opc" style="border: 0px solid black; display: inline; font-variant-numeric: inherit; font-variant-east-asian: inherit; font-variant-alternates: inherit; font-variant-position: inherit; font-stretch: inherit; font-size: 16px; line-height: inherit; font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif; font-optical-sizing: inherit; font-size-adjust: inherit; font-kerning: inherit; font-feature-settings: inherit; font-variation-settings: inherit; list-style: none; margin: 0px; padding: 0px; position: relative; white-space-collapse: preserve; overflow-wrap: break-word; min-width: 0px; text-overflow: unset; background-color: inherit;">

<span style="font-weight: bold; color: rgb(156, 0, 0);">・後者は最初から狙い撃ちして</span></span></font><span style="background-color: inherit; font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve; font-weight: bold; color: rgb(156, 0, 0);">顕在層を集めるので</span></p>
<p><font style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255);"><span class="css-1jxf684 r-bcqeeo r-1ttztb7 r-qvutc0 r-1tl8opc" style="border: 0px solid black; display: inline; font-variant-numeric: inherit; font-variant-east-asian: inherit; font-variant-alternates: inherit; font-variant-position: inherit; font-stretch: inherit; font-size: 16px; line-height: inherit; font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif; font-optical-sizing: inherit; font-size-adjust: inherit; font-kerning: inherit; font-feature-settings: inherit; font-variation-settings: inherit; list-style: none; margin: 0px; padding: 0px; position: relative; white-space-collapse: preserve; overflow-wrap: break-word; min-width: 0px; text-overflow: unset; background-color: inherit; font-weight: bold; color: rgb(156, 0, 0);">バックエンドが売れるまでのスパンが短く
</span></font></p>
<p><font style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255);"><span class="css-1jxf684 r-bcqeeo r-1ttztb7 r-qvutc0 r-1tl8opc" style="border: 0px solid black; display: inline; font-variant-numeric: inherit; font-variant-east-asian: inherit; font-variant-alternates: inherit; font-variant-position: inherit; font-stretch: inherit; font-size: 16px; line-height: inherit; font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif; font-optical-sizing: inherit; font-size-adjust: inherit; font-kerning: inherit; font-feature-settings: inherit; font-variation-settings: inherit; list-style: none; margin: 0px; padding: 0px; position: relative; white-space-collapse: preserve; overflow-wrap: break-word; min-width: 0px; text-overflow: unset; background-color: inherit; font-weight: bold; color: rgb(156, 0, 0);">比較的売れやすい</span></font></p>
<p><font style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255);"><span class="css-1jxf684 r-bcqeeo r-1ttztb7 r-qvutc0 r-1tl8opc" style="border: 0px solid black; display: inline; font-variant-numeric: inherit; font-variant-east-asian: inherit; font-variant-alternates: inherit; font-variant-position: inherit; font-stretch: inherit; font-size: 16px; line-height: inherit; font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif; font-optical-sizing: inherit; font-size-adjust: inherit; font-kerning: inherit; font-feature-settings: inherit; font-variation-settings: inherit; list-style: none; margin: 0px; padding: 0px; position: relative; white-space-collapse: preserve; overflow-wrap: break-word; min-width: 0px; text-overflow: unset; background-color: inherit;"></span></font></p>
<p><font style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255);"><span class="css-1jxf684 r-bcqeeo r-1ttztb7 r-qvutc0 r-1tl8opc" style="border: 0px solid black; display: inline; font-variant-numeric: inherit; font-variant-east-asian: inherit; font-variant-alternates: inherit; font-variant-position: inherit; font-stretch: inherit; font-size: 16px; line-height: inherit; font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif; font-optical-sizing: inherit; font-size-adjust: inherit; font-kerning: inherit; font-feature-settings: inherit; font-variation-settings: inherit; list-style: none; margin: 0px; padding: 0px; position: relative; white-space-collapse: preserve; overflow-wrap: break-word; min-width: 0px; text-overflow: unset; background-color: inherit;"></span></font></p>

<p><font style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255);"><span class="css-1jxf684 r-bcqeeo r-1ttztb7 r-qvutc0 r-1tl8opc" style="border: 0px solid black; display: inline; font-variant-numeric: inherit; font-variant-east-asian: inherit; font-variant-alternates: inherit; font-variant-position: inherit; font-stretch: inherit; font-size: 16px; line-height: inherit; font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif; font-optical-sizing: inherit; font-size-adjust: inherit; font-kerning: inherit; font-feature-settings: inherit; font-variation-settings: inherit; list-style: none; margin: 0px; padding: 0px; position: relative; white-space-collapse: preserve; overflow-wrap: break-word; min-width: 0px; text-overflow: unset; background-color: inherit;">

<p><span style="font-size: 16px;">%name2%さんこんばんは</span></p>
<span style="font-size: 16px;">
</span><p><span style="font-size: 16px;">おんゆーです。</span></p>
<span style="font-size: 16px;">
</span><p><br></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 16px;"><br>いよいよ明日からお盆休みですね。<br>僕は2、3日富山に行こうと思ってます<br></span><span style="font-size: 16px;"><br><br></span></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 16px;"></span></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 16px;">お盆休みやお正月など、<br>ちょっと長めの休みの時に<br>あるあるだと思うんですが</span></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 16px;"></span></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 16px;"></span></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 16px;"><br><br><br></span></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 16px;">家で集中して作業できなくないですか？</span></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 16px;">それが今日のテーマです。<br><br><br></span></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 16px;">では本題。</span></p>
<span style="font-size: 16px;">
</span><p><br></p>
<span style="font-size: 16px;">
</span><p><span style="font-size: 16px;">&nbsp;</span></p>
<span style="font-size: 16px;">
</span><p><b><span style="font-size: 16px;">%name2%さんは</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve;">ダーツしたことありますか？？</span></b></p>
<span style="font-size: 16px;">
</span><p><img src="%url18%{https://onyou24600720.com/sp/8LX86pOd/Nlwr1Dgi/images/IMG_4005.jpg}"><span style="white-space-collapse: preserve; font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px;">


ぜひ、</span></p>
<p><span style="white-space-collapse: preserve; font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px;">ダーツを作業に取り入れてみてください。</span></p>
<p><span style="white-space-collapse: preserve; font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px;">

</span></p>
<p><span style="white-space-collapse: preserve; font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px;">

「いやいや...ダーツと関係ないでしょ」

「ダーツしたらそれ作業してないじゃん」</span></p>
<p><span style="white-space-collapse: preserve; font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px;"></span></p>
<p><span style="white-space-collapse: preserve; font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px;">


って思うかもしれませんが、
ダーツといっても
実際にダーツをするわけではないんです(笑)</span></p>
<p><span style="white-space-collapse: preserve; font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px;"></span></p>
<p><span style="white-space-collapse: preserve; font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px;">

</span></p>
<p><span style="white-space-collapse: preserve; font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px;">

ゲーム形式を作業に取り入れるイメージ。</span></p>
<p><span style="white-space-collapse: preserve; font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px;"></span></p>
<p><span style="white-space-collapse: preserve; font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px;">



<b>ダーツの主なゲームの種類は、

・カウントアップ
・ゼロワン
・クリケット

この3つです。</b></span></p>
<p><span style="white-space-collapse: preserve; font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px;"><b></b></span></p>
<p><span style="white-space-collapse: preserve; font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px;"><b>

</b></span></p>
<p><span style="white-space-collapse: preserve; font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px;"><b>
</b>
カウントアップ=0点からスタートして
<b>点数が高い方が勝ち</b></span></p>
<p><span style="white-space-collapse: preserve; font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px;"></span></p>
<p><span style="white-space-collapse: preserve; font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px;">
</span></p>
<p><span style="white-space-collapse: preserve; font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px;">

ゼロワン＝</span></p>
<p><span style="white-space-collapse: preserve; font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px;">3&ldquo;01&rdquo;や5&ldquo;01&rdquo;から<b>数字を減らして先に0にした方が勝ち</b></span></p>
<p><span style="white-space-collapse: preserve; font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px;"></span></p>
<p><span style="white-space-collapse: preserve; font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px;"></span></p>
<p><span style="white-space-collapse: preserve; font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px;">
</span></p>
<p><span style="white-space-collapse: preserve; font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px;">
クリケット＝</span></p>
<p><span style="white-space-collapse: preserve; font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px;">15&#12316;20とど真ん中(ブル)に3回分入れたら</span></p>
<p><span style="white-space-collapse: preserve; font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px;">自分の陣地になる<b>陣取りゲーム</b>
</span></p>
<p><span style="white-space-collapse: preserve; font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px;"></span></p>
<p><span style="white-space-collapse: preserve; font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px;"></span></p>
<p><span style="white-space-collapse: preserve; font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px;">
</span></p>
<p><span style="white-space-collapse: preserve; font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px;">
で、

「ダーツと作業に何の関係があるんですか...？」

って話だと思うんですが、</span></p>
<p><span style="white-space-collapse: preserve; font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px;"></span></p>
<p><span style="white-space-collapse: preserve; font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px;"></span></p>
<p><span style="white-space-collapse: preserve; font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px;">
</span></p>
<p><span style="white-space-collapse: preserve; font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px;">
本当に&uarr;のゲーム形式を</span></p>
<p><span style="white-space-collapse: preserve; font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px;">タイマーを使って作業に落とし込むだけです。</span></p>
<p><span style="white-space-collapse: preserve; font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px;"></span></p>
<p><span style="white-space-collapse: preserve; font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px;">


キッチンタイマーやiPhoneの時計でOKです</span></p>
<p><span style="white-space-collapse: preserve; font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px;"></span></p>
<p><span style="white-space-collapse: preserve; font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px;">

</span></p>
<p><span style="white-space-collapse: preserve; font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px;">

<b>「カウントアップ」の場合は...</b></span></p>
<p><span style="white-space-collapse: preserve; font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px;"></span></p>
<p><span style="white-space-collapse: preserve; font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px;">

&darr;&darr;&darr;
==========
作業開始したらボタンを押す
&darr;
休憩する時に一時停止
&darr;
再開する時にボタンタップ
&darr;
繰り返し
==========</span></p>
<p><span style="white-space-collapse: preserve; font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px;"></span></p>
<p><span style="white-space-collapse: preserve; font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px;">
</span></p>
<p><span style="white-space-collapse: preserve; font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px;">

決して、
作業時間に満足するためにやるわけではないです。</span></p>
<p><span style="white-space-collapse: preserve; font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px;"></span></p>
<p><span style="white-space-collapse: preserve; font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px;">


時給は出ませんからね....


</span></p>
<p><span style="white-space-collapse: preserve; font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px;"></span></p>
<p><span style="white-space-collapse: preserve; font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px;">
1作業にかかった時間....
タイムアタック的な使い方がおすすめ。

</span></p>
<p><span style="white-space-collapse: preserve; font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px;"></span></p>
<p><span style="white-space-collapse: preserve; font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px;">

毎日RTAです
</span></p>
<p><span style="white-space-collapse: preserve; font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px;"></span></p>
<p><span style="white-space-collapse: preserve; font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px;">
</span></p>
<p><span style="white-space-collapse: preserve; font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px;">
<b>次に「ゼロワン」の場合...</b></span></p>
<p><span style="white-space-collapse: preserve; font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px;"></span></p>
<p><span style="white-space-collapse: preserve; font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px;">


&darr;&darr;&darr;&darr;
==========
タイマーを50分や60分に設定
&darr;
カウントダウン開始
&darr;
40、30、20、10、9、8と減っていく
&darr;
カウントダウン終了
&darr;
休憩
&darr;
再開
==========</span></p>
<p><span style="white-space-collapse: preserve; font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px;"></span></p>
<p><span style="white-space-collapse: preserve; font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px;">

</span></p>
<p><span style="white-space-collapse: preserve; font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px;">

いわゆるポモドーロ法ですね
集中力のない僕は普段から多用してます(笑)</span></p>
<p><span style="white-space-collapse: preserve; font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px;"></span></p>
<p><span style="white-space-collapse: preserve; font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px;"></span></p>
<p><span style="white-space-collapse: preserve; font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px;">
</span></p>
<p><span style="white-space-collapse: preserve; font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px;">

LPにカウントダウンを設けるのと同じ要領で、</span></p>
<p><span style="white-space-collapse: preserve; font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px;">自分自身にもカウントダウンを設けます。</span></p>
<p><span style="white-space-collapse: preserve; font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px;"></span></p>
<p><span style="white-space-collapse: preserve; font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px;"></span></p>
<p><span style="white-space-collapse: preserve; font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px;">

</span></p>
<p><span style="white-space-collapse: preserve; font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px;">

最後にクリケットの場合...</span></p>
<p><span style="white-space-collapse: preserve; font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px;"></span></p>
<p><span style="white-space-collapse: preserve; font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px;"></span></p>
<p><span style="white-space-collapse: preserve; font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px;">

</span></p>
<p><span style="white-space-collapse: preserve; font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px;">
&darr;&darr;&darr;&darr;&darr;
==========
大タスクを小タスクに3分割する
(1タスクあたり約33%)
&darr;
ひたすら小タスクを処理していく
&darr;
3回小タスクをクリアしたら、
1大タスク完了(33&times;3 ≒ 100%)
&darr;
繰り返し
==========</span></p>
<p><span style="white-space-collapse: preserve; font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px;"></span></p>
<p><span style="white-space-collapse: preserve; font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px;">
</span></p>
<p><span style="white-space-collapse: preserve; font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px;">
</span></p>
<p><span style="white-space-collapse: preserve; font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px;">

「クリケット作業法」
と勝手に命名しておきます</span></p>
<p><span style="white-space-collapse: preserve; font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px;"></span></p>
<p><span style="white-space-collapse: preserve; font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px;"></span></p>
<p><span style="white-space-collapse: preserve; font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px;">

</span></p>
<p><span style="white-space-collapse: preserve; font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px;"></span></p>
<p><span style="white-space-collapse: preserve; font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px;">

これはタイマーいらずで、
タスクを書き出すメモさえあれば
どこでもできます。</span></p>
<p><span style="white-space-collapse: preserve; font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px;"></span></p>
<p><span style="white-space-collapse: preserve; font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px;"></span></p>
<p><span style="white-space-collapse: preserve; font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px;">
</span></p>
<p><span style="white-space-collapse: preserve; font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px;">

</span></p>
<p><span style="white-space-collapse: preserve; font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px;">



他のゼロワンやカウントアップと
組み合わせて作業すると鬼捗ります。</span></p>
<p><span style="white-space-collapse: preserve; font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px;"></span></p>
<p><span style="white-space-collapse: preserve; font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px;"></span></p>
<p><span style="white-space-collapse: preserve; font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px;">
</span></p>
<p><span style="white-space-collapse: preserve; font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px;"></span></p>
<p><span style="white-space-collapse: preserve; font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px;">

コンテンツビジネスで成果を出すためには、
まず作業が大前提としてある程度必要。
</span></p>
<p><span style="white-space-collapse: preserve; font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px;"></span></p>
<p><span style="white-space-collapse: preserve; font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px;"></span></p>
<p><span style="white-space-collapse: preserve; font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px;">
</span></p>
<p><span style="white-space-collapse: preserve; font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px;">
少ない時間で集中して
作業効率を上げられるので、
</span></p>
<p><span style="white-space-collapse: preserve; font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px;"></span></p>
<p><span style="white-space-collapse: preserve; font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px;">


ローンチ前やタスク過多の時、
特に時間のない方にはおすすめですね。
</span></p>
<p><span style="white-space-collapse: preserve; font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px;"></span></p>
<p><span style="white-space-collapse: preserve; font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px;"></span></p>
<p><span style="white-space-collapse: preserve; font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px;">

</span></p>
<p><span style="white-space-collapse: preserve; font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px;">ではでは

</span></p>
<p><span style="white-space-collapse: preserve; font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px;"><b>＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝</b></span></p>
<p><b>%name2%さんの累計ポイント&darr;<br><span style="white-space-collapse: preserve; font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px;">
</span>%point%ポイント<br><span style="white-space-collapse: preserve; font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px;">
</span><span style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Meiryo, system-ui, -apple-system, &quot;system-ui&quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve;">＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝</span></b></p>

<p><img src="%url2%{https://onyou24600720.com/sp/8LX86pOd/Nlwr1Dgi/images/hnew.png}" width="600px" height="200px"></p>
<br><br><br><p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>%name2%さんこんばんは</p>
<p>おんゆーです。</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>最近LINEのバンが相次いでいますね...</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><br><br></p>
<p>そこで思うことがあるので、<br>ちょっと綴ってみようと思います。<br></p>
<p><br></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><br></p>
<p><b style="color: rgb(156, 0, 0);">「メルマガとLINEはどっちをやるべきなの？」</b></p>
<p>&nbsp;はずっと続いていますよね。<br><br></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>%name2%さんも<br>一度は悩まれたことがあるんじゃないでしょうか？<br></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><br><br><br></p>
<p>結論、</p>
<p><b>両方やりましょう。</b></p>
<p><b></b></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><br></p>
<p>「メルマガなんて誰も読まないんじゃない？」</p>
<p><br></p>
<p>「自分自身がメールをそんなに読まないから意味ないんじゃない？」</p>
<p><br></p>
<p>「開封率とか到達率はLINEより低いじゃん...」</p>
<p><br></p>
<p>とか、</p>
<p>%name2%さんは思うところもあると思います。</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><br></p>
<p>でも、実は、</p>
<p>メルマガは今でも超有効なメディアなんですね。</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>もちろん、</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><b>メルマガなんて必要ない！</b></p>
<p><b>LINEで十分成果は出せる！</b></p>
<p><b>Xだけで売上作れる！</b></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><br></p>
<p>という意見はその通りだと思います。</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><br></p>
<p>LINE、XやInstagramなど、</p>
<p><br></p>
<p>わざわざメルマガを使わなくても</p>
<p>収益を上げられるので、</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>メルマガを作る人が減ってきている</p>
<p>というのは事実。</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><br></p>
<p>メルマガを読む人たちも</p>
<p>相対的に減ってきているかもしれません。</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><br></p>
<p>でも0になったわけではなく、</p>
<p>こうして%name2%さんは読んでくれているわけで。</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><br></p>
<p>何が言いたいかというと、</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>メルマガは読みたい人たち、</p>
<p>読むべき人たちが読むようになったので</p>
<p><br></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>全体的な開封率は下がってはいるものの、</p>
<p>ビジネスにおける売上の効果(LTVなど)は</p>
<p>むしろよくなってます。</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>動画ほど強くはないけど<br></p>
<p>ファンも生まれやすいです。<br></p>
<p><br></p>
<p><br></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><br></p>
<p>動画を観るハードルが高い方や</p>
<p>長時間動画観るのがキツい方には</p>
<p>めちゃくちゃ刺さります。</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><br></p>
<p>何より毎日送れるので接触回数も増やせるし、</p>
<p>LTVをめちゃくちゃ高めやすい。</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><br></p>
<p>実際、僕の発信でも</p>
<p>メルマガをしっかり読んでくださる方が</p>
<p>コンテンツを買ってくださるケースが大半。</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><br></p>
<p>LINE完結で毎日教育配信をしようとすると</p>
<p>垢BANリスクが上がったり、</p>
<p>ブロック率が上がったりと、</p>
<p><br></p>
<p><b>教育には不向きな面も多い</b>ですしね。</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><br></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>Xだと週に一回は誰かの凍結報告を見ますよね。</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><br></p>
<p>まぁここまでメルマガを絶賛してますが、</p>
<p>個人的にはYouTubeもメルマガもLINEも全てやる。</p>
<p><br></p>
<p><b style="color: rgb(156, 0, 0);">使えるものは全て使うスタンスです。</b></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><br></p>
<p>ただ僕の場合は</p>
<p>メルマガが全ての軸であり、</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><br></p>
<p><span style="font-weight: bold;">メルマガを読んでもらうための<span style="color: rgb(0, 255, 0);">LINE</span>、</span></p>
<p><span style="font-weight: bold;">メルマガと併用してより伝わりやすい形で</span></p>
<p><span style="font-weight: bold;">価値を提供するための<span style="color: rgb(156, 0, 0);">YouTube</span>。</span></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><br></p>
<p>という位置付けです。</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><span style="font-weight: bold;">改めて結論、</span></p>
<p><span style="font-weight: bold; color: rgb(156, 0, 0);">安全上、リスク、長期的なビジネスの観点から、</span></p>
<p><span style="font-weight: bold; color: rgb(156, 0, 0);">LINEとメルマガの両方でリストを取りましょう。</span></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><br></p>
<p><span style="font-weight: bold; font-size: 17px;">０&rarr;１００思考ではなくて、</span></p>
<p><span style="font-weight: bold; font-size: 17px;"></span></p>
<p><span style="font-weight: bold; font-size: 17px;">各媒体の特徴を理解して、使えるものは全て使って</span></p>
<p><span style="font-weight: bold; font-size: 17px;">上手く組み合わせるのが最強です。</span></p>
<p><span style="font-weight: bold; font-size: 17px;"></span></p>
<p><span style="font-weight: bold; font-size: 17px;"></span></p>
<p><span style="font-weight: bold; font-size: 17px;"></span></p>
<p><span style="font-weight: bold; font-size: 17px;"></span></p>
<p><span style="font-weight: bold; font-size: 17px;"></span></p>
<p><span style="font-weight: bold; font-size: 17px;">この&rdquo;特徴&rdquo;について</span></p>
<p><span style="font-weight: bold; font-size: 17px;">需要があれば今後話していこうと思います。</span></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><br></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>

<p>今まで受けてきた</p>
<p>オファーの数と種類に左右されます。</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><br><br><br></p>
<p>しかもコレって</p>
<p>「買う前」「買う時」はもちろん、</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><br><br><br></p>
<p>「買った後」にまで響いてくるので恐ろしいです。</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><br><br><br></p>
<p>購入された後に良いサポートを提供しようと思っても、</p>
<p><br></p>
<p>良いサポートを受けたことがなかったら</p>
<p>それがどんなものかわからないので</p>
<p>提供・再現のしようがないんですね。</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><br><br><br></p>
<p>一般的にノウハウコレクターは良くないとされがちですが、</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><br><br><br></p>
<p>仕掛ける側になった時には</p>
<p>圧倒的優位に立てます。</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><br><br><br></p>
<p>売り方は学べば良い話と思うかもしれません。</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><br><br>で・す・が<br><br></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><br></p>
<p>具体例といっしょに知識・枠組みとしては理解できても</p>
<p><br></p>
<p>実践段階で、</p>
<p>実際どうやるの？問題が発生します。</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><br><br><br></p>
<p>そしてもう一つ大きなものが欠けてます。</p>
<p>【感情】です。</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><br><br><br></p>
<p>事例をただ眺めてたって</p>
<p>感情が動かないんですよ。</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><br><br><br></p>
<p>特に発信者として長くやってると</p>
<p>目が肥えて、結構シビアに投資対効果を考えるようになるんですね。</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><br><br><br></p>
<p>実際、ありふれた商品・訴求では</p>
<p>買う気が全く起きないものです。</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><br><br><br></p>
<p>何でもいいから買え！</p>
<p><br></p>
<p>と言ってるわけでは決してなくて</p>
<p><br><br></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><br></p>
<p>ちゃんと自分で手足を動かして</p>
<p>ジャンル問わず普段から色んな商品を見てオファーされるのが大事ってことです。</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><br><br><br></p>
<p>何より動かないと売り方の変化にも気づけないし試す余地もない。</p>
<p><br></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><br><br>本来の意味とは少し違いますが、やはり...</p>
<p><br></p>
<p>定期的に<span style="font-weight: bold;">&ldquo;顧客体験&rdquo;</span>をするのがおすすめです。</p>
<p><br></p>
<p>顧客目線を持つっていうのは</p>
<p>顧客になった人だけができる芸当ですからね</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><br><br><br></p>
<p>え？私ですか？？</p>
<p><br></p>
<p>ええ、最近ゴリッゴリッに売られました。</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><br><br></p>
<p><br></p>
<p>先日新しいツールを導入したんですが、</p>
<p>コンセプト、導線、オファー、<br>ビジネスモデルの全てが美しすぎて感動しました(笑)</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><br><br><br></p>
<p>ワンタイムオファーでアップセルもあったんですが、</p>
<p>ツール欲しさよりも「その先を見たくて」</p>
<p>買ったまであります。</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><br><br><br></p>
<p>その話はまたどこかでします...笑</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><br></p>
<p>%name2%さんもコンテンツに限らず<br>日常生活で最近買って</p>
<p>「売り方うまいな&#12316;」って思ったものとかあります？？</p>
<p><br></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>あればぜひポストのリプで教えてください</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><a href="%url3%{https://x.com/nishishi0720/status/1809131313376735701?s=46&t=u8VF6bAACzGGKTBZAfmDNQ}" class="docs-creator"><img src="%url5%{https://onyou24600720.com/sp/8LX86pOd/Nlwr1Dgi/images/amazn3.png}" width="500px" height="200px"></a><br><br><br><br></p>
<p>ではでは&#12316;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
